npc:aelthalyste.text: Aelthalyste. Aelthalyste is a banshee priest trainer and prominent figure among the Forsaken priesthood, stationed in the War Quarter of the Undercity. She oversees the spiritual discipline of Forsaken acolytes, teaching them to wield the dark energies of Shadow. She also coordinates with other Horde faith leaders, directing troll acolytes to their own elders in Orgrimmar. Unlike many priests across Azeroth who revere the Holy Light, Aelthalyste guides Forsaken priests who have turned from the Light toward the power of shadow. Rising as an incorporeal banshee, she embodies the spectral agony and relentless resolve of Sylvanas Windrunner's followers. From her chamber in the Undercity's War Quarter, she calls aspiring priests back from distant outposts to master the darker arts of their discipline, teaching them to harness suffering as a lethal weapon. While her focus remains firmly on her Forsaken flock, Aelthalyste maintains mutual respect with other Horde spiritual practitioners. Recognizing the distinct nature of Darkspear spiritualism, she directs troll initiates away from her own shadow doctrines and sends them across the sea to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar. This gesture of deference ensures that Horde spellcasters develop within their cultural traditions while cementing alliances between Kalimdor and Lordaeron.

npc:ahanu.text: Ahanu. Ahanu is a tauren merchant operating within Hewa's Armory on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff. He crafts and trades leather armor to travelers and young braves setting out across Mulgore and the wider plains. He also helps newly arrived couriers navigate the bluffs when delivering messages from nearby settlements. Situated amidst the leatherworking stalls and armories of Thunder Bluff's lower rise, Ahanu provides vital equipment to those who make their living across Kalimdor's grasslands. Working hides sent by his friend Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads, he represents the everyday tradesfolk who keep the tauren capital supplied with durable cured and tanned hide gear. For travelers fresh off a wind rider from the Crossroads, Ahanu frequently serves as a first point of contact in the grand city, receiving deliveries and directing messengers toward the local flight roosts.

npc:alamar-grimm.text: Alamar Grimm. Alamar Grimm is a gnome warlock trainer stationed in Coldridge Valley at Anvilmar. Bitter over the tragic loss of Gnomeregan, he distrusts outsiders and focuses on teaching fledgling warlocks how to harness dark arts and summon their first demonic minions. While most gnomes in Coldridge Valley channel their energies into recovery and tinkering, Alamar Grimm harbors a deep resentment over the fall of Gnomeregan. He holds a cynical view of standard adventurers and even the host dwarves of Ironforge, grumbling that their allies care more about diplomacy with humans than reclaiming the fallen techno-city. Operating from Anvilmar, he seeks kindred spirits who understand that ruthless power may be what his people truly need. To young gnomes walking the path of fel magic, Grimm serves as an initial guide. When presented with a tainted memorandum, he offers a rare warm reception and begins tutoring recruits in fundamental spells. Before granting a novice the dangerous knowledge required to bind a demonic imp, however, he demands proof of their magical and physical endurance by sending them to retrieve the strange feather charms carried by local Frostmane troll novices.

npc:altsoba-ragetotem.text: Altsoba Ragetotem. Altsoba Ragetotem is a tauren weaponsmith stationed at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood. From this remote Horde outpost, he keeps passing champions armed with reliable maces, staves, and axes to face the blighted horrors of the forest. Bloodvenom Post is a treacherous outpost, situated in the heart of Felwood amidst demonic corruption and tainted wildlife. Maintaining a supply line out here is a grim necessity, and Altsoba Ragetotem does his part by outfitting Horde scouts and travelers. Whether someone requires a sturdy crescent axe or a heavy war maul, Altsoba ensures warriors heading into the corrupted timberlands do not enter the fray unarmed.

npc:alyissia.text: Alyissia. Alyissia is a kaldorei warrior trainer stationed inside the hollow boughs of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. She guides newly awakened night elf warriors in the fundamentals of martial combat, helping them harness raw strength and discipline to defend their nascent world tree. Standing within the sheltered sanctuary of Aldrassil, Alyissia instructs young night elves who feel drawn to the path of steel and shield rather than nature magic or the priesthood. While the kaldorei military is traditionally renowned for its Sentinels and stealthy archers, the perilous state of modern Kalimdor requires resolute frontline fighters. Alyissia teaches foundational techniques, ensuring that fresh recruits can direct their battle fury, master their stances, and withstand the aggressive wildlife and corrupted grells encroaching on Shadowglen.

npc:amber-kearnen.text: Amber Kearnen. Amber Kearnen is a sharp-eyed operative of SI:7 stationed deep in Westfall. From her concealed vantage point overlooking the plains, she monitors the illicit activities of the Defias Brotherhood on behalf of Master Mathias Shaw. An agent of SI:7, Amber Kearnen serves as one of Stormwind's field scouts. Rather than walking the halls of Stormwind Keep, she operates under the open skies of Westfall, watching over an abandoned watchtower commandeered by the Defias Brotherhood. Under the direct leadership of Master Mathias Shaw, Kearnen provides critical oversight and briefing for covert operatives sent to neutralize Defias threats and gather intelligence across the contested countryside.

npc:andron-gant.text: Andron Gant. Andron Gant is a reclusive, frequently intoxicated Forsaken residing in the murky depths of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He handles occasional research commissions for local mages. Lounging amidst the noxious fumes of the Apothecarium, Andron Gant rarely ventures beyond the safety of the Undercity's stone walls. To the casual observer, he appears to be little more than a drunken scholar, occasionally hiring adventurous couriers to retrieve obscure relics like the Tablet of Markri from distant shores on behalf of local mages.

npc:anduin-wrynn.text: Anduin Wrynn. Anduin Llane Wrynn is the ten-year-old crowned King of Stormwind, reigning in the absence of his missing father, King Varian Wrynn. Due to his young age, the true administration of the kingdom rests in the hands of Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the royal court. Born in the peaceful interlude following the Second War, Prince Anduin was named in honor of both his grandfather King Llane and the legendary knight Sir Anduin Lothar. Following the mysterious disappearance of his father en route to a diplomatic summit in Theramore, the child was abruptly crowned to maintain stability throughout the kingdom. Though intelligent and empathetic beyond his years, the ten-year-old monarch has little actual say in state affairs, leaving rule of the realm divided between Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and royal councilor Lady Katrana Prestor. Within the gilded walls of Stormwind Keep, young Anduin is surrounded by escalating political tension. While Highlord Bolvar manages military defenses and strives to maintain the integrity of the kingdom, the noblewoman Katrana Prestor constantly whispers counsel into the court's ear, actively undermining troop deployments to outlying human settlements. Anduin senses the precarious nature of his court and misses his father dearly, yet for now, he remains a figurehead surrounded by scheming nobles and watchful guardians.

npc:apothecary-helbrim.text: Apothecary Helbrim. Apothecary Helbrim is an emissary of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in the dusty heart of the Crossroads. Sent all the way to Kalimdor to harvest unfamiliar reagents, he studies the native flora and strange ecology of the Barrens on behalf of the Forsaken. While most of the Royal Apothecary Society remains sequestered in the damp underbelly of the Undercity, Helbrim operates out of the harsh sun and parched red dirt of the Crossroads. Sent far across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, his mission is simple yet crucial: identify and extract useful flora, fungi, and natural specimens from the Barrens. To this end, he relies on passing adventurers to gather samples, such as local fungal spores, and coordinates directly with his colleague, Apothecary Zamah, over in Thunder Bluff. His presence reminds travellers that the reach of Sylvanas's alchemists extends well beyond the ruined borders of Lordaeron.

npc:apothecary-zinge.text: Apothecary Zinge. Apothecary Zinge is an alchemist and researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in the Apothecarium beneath the ruins of Lordaeron. Working in service to the Forsaken, she investigates biological specimens and coordinates research shipments across Horde territories. Apothecary Zinge conducts experiments deep within the murky quarters of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Like her colleagues under Master Apothecary Faranell, she seeks chemical and biological compounds that can further the goals of the Forsaken. Her research often connects her with field researchers and scouts stationed far beyond the boundaries of Tirisfal Glades, including exchanges with remote outposts in Kalimdor. To refine her formulas and uncover new reagents, Zinge relies on couriers and adventurers to relay test materials across the seas. She maintains regular correspondence with colleagues such as Apothecary Helbrim stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, sending him toxic wolf heart samples from Silverpine Forest so he can study the effects of Lordaeron's toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.

npc:archaeologist-flagongut.text: Archaeologist Flagongut. Archaeologist Flagongut is a dwarven scholar representing the Explorers' League, stationed within the Deepwater Tavern at Menethil Harbor. Though originally en route to the local dig at the Whelgar Excavation Site, he becomes an important contact for field reports traveling across the sea from Darkshore. Archaeologist Flagongut can be found resting with a mug in hand at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Like many members of Ironforge's Explorers' League, he traveled west across Khaz Modan aiming to assist with discoveries near the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. Despite being far from the high halls of the library, he maintains vital ties with field researchers, helping process lost relics and reports ferried across the Great Sea from remote expeditions. Dwarven curiosity is rarely confined to one continent. When the mysterious fossil that the absent-minded Prospector Remtravel unearthed in Darkshore is sent on to him by Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus, Flagongut is amazed: he once brought a fossil much like it to the Explorers' League's annual conference in Ironforge, convinced it held a power that could somehow be unlocked.

npc:archaeologist-hollee.text: Archaeologist Hollee. Archaeologist Hollee is a dwarven researcher stationed in the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Working on behalf of dwarven excavation interests, she keeps tabs on archaeological findings and surveys throughout the ancient, fog-shrouded wilderness of Darkshore. She frequently coordinates with prospectors scouring the region for relics and geological anomalies. While Darkshore is predominantly guarded and settled by the night elves, the presence of dwarven scholars like Archaeologist Hollee reflects Ironforge's growing curiosity about Kalimdor. The Explorers' League sends representatives far across the seas to uncover traces of ancient history, and Darkshore's ruins offer tempting ground for study. Hollee makes her temporary base out of Auberdine, acting as a regional contact for wandering surveyors and expedition teams.

npc:archbishop-benedictus.text: Archbishop Benedictus. Archbishop Benedictus is the supreme spiritual leader of the Church of the Holy Light, presiding over the faithful from the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. Once the devoted student of Archbishop Alonsus Faol, he now guides the moral and religious heart of the Alliance during a time of immense uncertainty. Benedictus rose to leadership following the death of his revered mentor, Archbishop Alonsus Faol. Having witnessed the devastation of the First and Second Wars, Benedictus helped oversee the construction of the grand Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, vowing to preserve the virtues of the faith. With the fall of Lordaeron and the rise of the Scourge during the Third War, the weight of the human kingdoms' spiritual guidance fell squarely on his shoulders. From his altar, he offers counsel to the royal court, trains newly initiated priests, and directs holy crusades against the undead and demonic forces threatening Azeroth. Regarded across the Alliance as a gentle, wise, and benevolent patriarch, Benedictus presents an unyielding beacon of hope to the public, rallying heroes to vanquish dark threats such as Amnennar the Coldbringer in Kalimdor and assisting in purifying cursed relics brought by faithful adventurers.

npc:archmage-ansirem-runeweaver.text: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver. Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver is a senior human wizard and a ruling member of Dalaran's Council of Six. Having survived the Scourge's destruction of Dalaran in the Third War, he oversees Kirin Tor operations from the Violet Citadel as Dalaran is rebuilt. Though dedicated to the rebuilding of his city, he also maintains discreet interests abroad—including a willful daughter who ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate. A veteran mage who helped defend Dalaran across decades, Ansirem Runeweaver sits on the Council of Six, the ruling magocracy of the Kirin Tor. He survived the devastation when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge marched upon the city and Archimonde was summoned. In the wake of Dalaran's fall, Ansirem has aided the efforts to rebuild the arcane city, whose protective shield was lifted early, and now works from the Violet Citadel. Despite his scholarly duties and stern wizardly demeanor, Ansirem possesses personal ties far beyond the Alterac Mountains. His willful daughter, Catelyn, ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate, taking with her an ancient troll dagger he had found while researching in Stranglethorn. He has also dealt with Baron Revilgaz there. He has also engaged in arcane studies involving troll antiquities and maintains diplomatic conduits across distant realms.

npc:archmage-malin.text: Archmage Malin. Archmage Malin is a senior human wizard stationed just outside the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. A former pupil of Archmage Trelane, Malin coordinates arcane affairs and field operatives dispatched to recover magical artifacts and rare reagents across the Eastern Kingdoms. Standing sentinel beneath the towering spiral of the Wizard's Sanctum, Archmage Malin serves as a central point of contact for the arcane practitioners of Stormwind. He learned his craft under the tutelage of Archmage Trelane, a storied mage whose scattered legacy Malin now strives to protect. While younger acolytes study theory within the tower's swirling blue portals, Malin keeps his focus trained outward on matters across the realm that demand magical oversight. Much of Malin's attention is directed north to the perilous ruins of the Arathi Highlands. To recover Archmage Trelane's lost possessions and secure delicate spell components, Malin dispatched his trusted associates, Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten, into the field. Coordinating these distant operations from the capital, Malin relies on capable Alliance travelers to carry instructions, supplies, and intelligence to his agents operating in hostile territory.

npc:archmage-xylem.text: Archmage Xylem. Archmage Xylem is an eccentric and reclusive human wizard dwelling in an isolated tower atop the cliffs of northern Azshara. Known for his volatile temperament and dangerous experiments, he has withdrawn from worldly affairs to pursue esoteric arcane research. Reaching him requires magical teleportation, and he only entertains adventurers who can assist in his peculiar studies or aid his personal vendettas. Perched high upon the jagged cliffs of northern Azshara, Archmage Xylem makes his home in a secluded spire overlooking the ruined elven coastline. Rather than building a road or trail, the wizard isolated his sanctuary entirely, relying on his servant Sanath Lim-yo to magically transport approved visitors up the cliff face. Observers across Kalimdor consider him profoundly eccentric and perilous to deal with; even fellow scholars treat him with deep caution, noting that he behaves unlike almost any other human mage.

npc:argent-guard-manados.text: Argent Guard Manados. Argent Guard Manados is a night elf sentry stationed in Darnassus on behalf of the Argent Dawn. Resting at the Craftsmen's Terrace, he keeps watch over Kalimdor's growing corruption and directs adventurers toward the sinister forces lurking in Blackfathom Deeps. While most of the Argent Dawn focuses its vigilance on the blighted lands of Lordaeron and the Scourge, Argent Guard Manados represents their watchful eyes in the night elf capital of Darnassus. Standing among the artisans and tradefolk of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Manados monitors emerging threats that menace the balance of northern Kalimdor. When rumors reach him of the Twilight's Hammer cult establishing a foul foothold beneath the waves of Ashenvale, Manados enlists capable heroes to strike at Blackfathom Deeps and recover artifacts of their dark devotion.

npc:argos-nightwhisper.text: Argos Nightwhisper. Argos Nightwhisper is a night elf emissary found in the Park district of Stormwind City. He serves as an Alliance contact directing adventurers to Darkshore, where his brother Gershala studies the spreading corruption. Argos Nightwhisper resides among the growing night elf presence in Stormwind, often lingering in the lush, secluded Park district crafted to remind the kaldorei of their ancestral woodlands. Like many of his kin stationed in the human kingdom, Argos acts as a bridge between the newfound allies across the Great Sea. Deeply concerned by reports filtering across the ocean, he urges capable Alliance champions to make the long journey to Auberdine in Darkshore, where his brother Gershala needs help against the spreading corruption.

npc:ashlan-stonesmirk.text: Ashlan Stonesmirk. Ashlan Stonesmirk is a dwarven explosives expert assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span in the northern Wetlands. From there, he keeps a vigilant eye on regional dangers threatening the realm of Ironforge. Positioned at Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, Ashlan Stonesmirk serves the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. His expertise with explosives makes him a useful contact when suspicious materials threaten dwarven defenses.

npc:austil-de-mon.text: Austil de Mon. Austil de Mon is a Forsaken warrior trainer stationed in Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Based out of the Gallows' End Tavern, he instructs newly risen warriors looking to hone their martial prowess in service of the Dark Lady. Found inside the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Austil de Mon serves as one of the earliest instructors for Forsaken warriors venturing out of Deathknell. While the living once populated the inn to drink and rest, Austil now uses the gloomy refuge to teach newly liberated undead how to channel raw martial discipline and ruthless combat techniques against the kingdom's surrounding foes.

npc:ayanna-everstride.text: Ayanna Everstride. Ayanna Everstride is a kaldorei hunter trainer stationed in Aldrassil within the Shadowglen of Teldrassil. She instructs fledgling night elf rangers in the foundational arts of marksmanship, tracking, and wilderness survival. Young hunters taking their first steps beneath the boughs of the World Tree seek her guidance to hone their woodland discipline. Perched inside Aldrassil at the very heart of the Shadowglen, Ayanna Everstride stands ready to instruct newly awakened kaldorei in the ways of the wild. To the night elves, a hunter is not merely a trapper or sharpshooter, but an indispensable guardian of the sacred forests. Ayanna provides guidance on early martial techniques, helping novices master ranged combat and survive in the perilous woods of Teldrassil.

npc:ayessa-dawnsinger.text: Ayessa Dawnsinger. Ayessa Dawnsinger is a Skyborne leader found in Valanaar on Zephras Isle. She leads the Windshapers, guiding the Skyborne aligned with the Horde through their trials and politics. Standing within the settlement of Valanaar on Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger serves as the paramount guide for the Windshapers—the faction of Skyborne aligned with the Horde. From this vantage, she directs critical efforts across the island, managing external threats, internal fractures, and the overarching survival of her people as they navigate alliances in Kalimdor and beyond.

npc:azar-stronghammer.text: Azar Stronghammer. Azar Stronghammer is a dwarven paladin stationed at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Having completed his own training in the holy arts, he guides newly awakened dwarven champions of the Holy Light and directs promising recruits toward higher instruction in Ironforge. While paladins are more commonly associated with the great cathedrals of humanity, the dwarves of Khaz Modan have fully embraced the virtues of the Holy Light. Stationed at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Azar Stronghammer watches over newly inducted dwarven paladins finding their footing amidst Dun Morogh's freezing slopes. Having mastered his own martial and spiritual vows, he serves as an approachable mentor. When a novice shows enough dedication and spiritual maturity, Azar directs them up the mountain path to Ironforge to study under veteran champions such as Tiza Battleforge.

npc:azuregos.text: Azuregos. Azuregos is an eccentric blue dragon stationed along the coast of Azshara to protect ancient Highborne relics. Entrusted with safeguarding immense magical power by the Spell-Weaver Malygos, he prefers quiet study over violence, but he will readily swat aside any adventurer foolish enough to disturb his vigil. Drawn to the magic-soaked shores of Azshara, Azuregos chose the ancient ruins of Eldarath as his sanctuary. Countless relics survived the Great Sundering along these shattered coasts, and Azuregos considers it his sacred duty as a servant of Malygos to keep such powerful artifacts away from careless mortals. Rather than lurking in a dark cave, he freely roams the crags and beaches, proudly dubbing himself the lord of all magic in the region. Though blessed with a sardonic sense of humor, he fiercely defends Azshara's treasures against the endless stream of adventurers seeking fame or plunder.

npc:bailiff-conacher.text: Bailiff Conacher. Bailiff Conacher serves in the Lakeshire Town Hall as the chief enforcement officer under Magistrate Solomon. Tasked with maintaining civil order and administering local decrees, he turns to independent champions to enforce the laws of Stormwind across the embattled Redridge Mountains. Within the Lakeshire Town Hall, Bailiff Conacher works closely with Magistrate Solomon to uphold lawful authority in the Redridge Mountains. With the town besieged on all fronts by Blackrock orcs and local gnolls, Conacher cannot rely on standard civic procedures or royal garrisons. Instead, he issues legal decrees that grant passing travelers the authority to administer capital justice on behalf of the realm. When the dark mage Morganth occupied the Tower of Ilgalar and subjugated the local Shadowhide gnolls to his will, the Court of Lakeshire deemed the beasts complicit in high treason. Since aiding a fugitive and criminal of the Kingdom of Stormwind carries a sentence of death, Conacher invokes Solomon's Law. He directs adventurers to scour the ridges for Shadowhide gnolls, demanding their pendants as legal proof that the crown's law has been carried out.

npc:bailor-stonehand.text: Bailor Stonehand. Bailor Stonehand is a skilled dwarven smith residing in Thelsamar within Loch Modan. Renowned for his metallurgical expertise, he once mentored the human weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell and produces a specialized alloy crucial for masterwork armaments. Currently, his forge work faces setbacks after local Mo'grosh ogres ambushed and stole his ore shipments. Operating in the dwarven settlement of Thelsamar, Bailor Stonehand represents the enduring craft of Loch Modan's blacksmiths. Known for his keen eye for raw minerals and his ability to smelt specialized alloys, Bailor's knowledge extends beyond Khaz Modan. He served as a mentor to the renowned human smith Jordan Stilwell, teaching him the foundational arts of metallurgy and sharing formulas that would later prove essential in forging blessed paladin armaments such as Verigan's Fist. Despite his quiet mastery, Bailor's trade is not immune to the rising threats in Loch Modan. Shipments of high-grade ore destined for his forge have fallen prey to the Mo'grosh ogres entrenched in the hills to the northeast. Without raw materials, Bailor finds himself unable to craft his rare alloys, forcing him to rely on passing travelers and allies to reclaim his stolen supplies from the brute encampments.

npc:balir-frosthammer.text: Balir Frosthammer. Balir Frosthammer is a dwarven defender stationed in Coldridge Valley within Dun Morogh. Alarmed by the sudden and aggressive incursions of Rockjaw troggs into dwarven lands, he recruits fledgling adventurers to stem the tide before the valley is overrun. Perched in the snowy enclave of Coldridge Valley, Balir Frosthammer watches the perimeter against encroaching dangers. The valley has long served as a safe haven and training ground for dwarven and gnomish novices, but recent disturbances underground have unleashed violent Rockjaw troggs onto the surface. Balir is among the first to sound the alarm, rallying newly arrived recruits to cull the troggs before they breach deeper into Dun Morogh. Bearing the proud Frosthammer surname, Balir may share a lineage with Tannok Frosthammer of Kharanos. Their family stands resolute in their duty to Ironforge, ensuring that the cold mountain passes remain secure for travelers, miners, and mountaineers even as regional threats multiply.

npc:barithras-moonshade.text: Barithras Moonshade. Barithras Moonshade is a night elf resident of Auberdine in Darkshore. Positioned within the coastal settlement, he seeks the help of adventurers willing to explore the shadowy wilderness and gather rare subterranean flora. Standing watch within the village of Auberdine, Barithras Moonshade contributes to the night elves' efforts to study and manage the unsettled land of Darkshore. He directs travelers to venture into nearby subterranean caverns to harvest specific fungi, such as death cap mushrooms, for study and use. Beyond local flora, Barithras assists in guiding capable adventurers southward to make contact with Onu, one of the venerable ancients striving to heal Darkshore's tainted soil and soothe its restless natural spirits.

npc:barkeep-daniels.text: Barkeep Daniels. Barkeep Daniels tends the counter at the Lakeshire Inn, serving weary town guards, local fishermen, and visiting travelers. With the Blackrock clan raiding across the Redridge Mountains and cutting off supply routes, keeping the tavern fully stocked has become an uphill battle. Behind the counter of the Lakeshire Inn stands Barkeep Daniels, pouring drinks and greeting whoever wanders in from the bridge. Lakeshire has spent months under constant pressure from gnolls and the Blackrock orcs, and the town's defenders rely on the tavern to unwind after grim patrols. Unfortunately for Daniels, the severed roads and relentless attacks have disrupted trade throughout the region. Finding himself dangerously low on liquor during a time when the town needs good cheer most, he is eager for any passing adventurer willing to fetch shipments from safer settlements.

npc:baron-revilgaz.text: Baron Revilgaz. Baron Revilgaz is the cunning goblin leader of Booty Bay and the Blackwater Raiders, ruling the pirate haven on behalf of the Steamwheedle Cartel. Perched high on the balcony of the Salty Sailor Tavern, he balances fragile trade neutrality with ruthlessly pragmatic opportunism. He hires passing mercenaries to secure his investments, undermine rivals like the Bloodsail Buccaneers, and retrieve ancient relics of the jungle. From his vantage atop the Salty Sailor Tavern, Baron Revilgaz watches the bustling docks of Blackwater Cove through a custom enchanted spyglass. Flanked by his trusted advisor, the tauren Fleet Master Seahorn, Revilgaz exercises firm control over the town's cutpurses, merchants, and privateers. Originally a human settlement overwhelmed by trolls before the First War, the port was claimed and fortified by goblins, eventually evolving into the pirate-leaning commercial nexus of the Blackwater Raiders. Revilgaz ensures the port remains officially open to both Alliance and Horde travelers, strictly enforcing neutrality within harbor limits so that trade continues uninterrupted. Revilgaz's influence extends far past the harbor docks. When business stagnated following recent wars elsewhere in Azeroth, he seized upon the discovery of tastyfish to establish the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza, drawing crowds back to his shores. Across Stranglethorn Vale, he keeps a sharp eye on competitors and potential threats: he commissions sabotage against the Venture Company at Lake Nazferiti, closely monitors Nesingwary's hunting expedition and rogue human military camps in the north, and maintains racing trade ties with Monte Gazlowe and Pozzik at the Mirage Raceway.

npc:bartleby.text: Bartleby. Bartleby is a bellicose drunkard loitering within the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Stormwind's Old Town. Known for his stubborn grip on his ale, he serves as an early martial test for aspiring warriors looking to prove their mettle in a good old-fashioned tavern brawl. Tucked away in the narrow, cobblestone alleys of Old Town, the Pig and Whistle Tavern draws a rougher, more weathered crowd than the pristine taprooms of the Cathedral Square. Bartleby is one of its most persistent fixtures. Clinging tightly to his favorite mug and fueled by cheap ale, he spends his days nursing grievances and picking fights with anyone unfortunate enough to disturb his drinking. While Bartleby looks like any other neighborhood drunk, Stormwind's warrior trainers see practical value in him. Harry Burlguard regularly directs fledgling fighters to track Bartleby down and relieve him of his mug. Taking the mug requires trading bare-knuckle blows with the intoxicated brawler, proving whether a novice warrior possesses the grit to handle an unruly opponent up close.

npc:bashana-runetotem.text: Bashana Runetotem. Bashana Runetotem is an herbalist and druidic researcher residing on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. The daughter of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, she aids the Cenarion Circle by overseeing agricultural investigations and guiding Horde adventurers against corrupting forces. Standing atop the breezy heights of the Elder Rise, Bashana Runetotem carries on the druidic legacy of her father, Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. While her father guides the burgeoning tauren druids and advises Cairne Bloodhoof, Bashana focuses on practical research into botanical anomalies and regional threats. She equips travelers with tools like evergreen pouches to cultivate mysterious flora, notably the enigmatic morrowgrain, while also coordinating Horde efforts to cleanse foul corruption spreading from places like Blackfathom Deeps.

npc:bath-rah-the-windwatcher.text: Bath'rah the Windwatcher. Bath'rah the Windwatcher is a solitary jungle troll shaman and weaponcrafter dwelling amidst the ruins near Chillwind Point. Far from his tropical homelands, he studies the tempestuous elements of the northern mountains, seeking champions powerful enough to help him craft formidable weapons of wind. While most jungle trolls keep to the warm forests and coasts of the south, Bath'rah has embraced the solitary life of a mountain hermit among the cold ruins of the Alterac Mountains. A seasoned shaman and craftsman, he devotes his days to listening to the howling winds and communing with nature spirits. His obsession is not merely philosophical; he seeks to bind the fury of violent elemental storms into tangible armaments for those who possess the strength to wield them.

npc:beldin-steelgrill.text: Beldin Steelgrill. Beldin Steelgrill is a renowned dwarven engineer and the master technician operating Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Widely regarded as one of the finest siege engine mechanics in Khaz Modan, he oversees the maintenance of the Ironforge military's heavy armor and treaded warmachines. Keeping those massive contraptions running requires an endless supply of high-grade specialized tools. Situated just down the road from Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot serves as the primary proving ground and service station for dwarven steam tanks and siege engines. Beldin Steelgrill stands as its chief technician, celebrated far and wide for his unmatched expertise in repairing and tuning armored war wagons. Taming heavy metal and rumbling boilers is unforgiving work, and Beldin burns through gear rapidly. His constant demand for heavy wrenches, cutters, and precision instruments frequently pushes local ironworkers to their limits just to keep his workbench supplied.

npc:bingles-blastenheimer.text: Bingles Blastenheimer. Bingles Blastenheimer is an eccentric gnomish aviator stranded on the southeastern shores of the Loch in Loch Modan. Having crash-landed his experimental flying machine, he finds himself marooned amidst local troggs and beasts, desperate to salvage his precious tools and components. Like many ambitious gnomish engineers, Bingles Blastenheimer took to the skies in a customized flying craft, only to discover that coming down safely is far more difficult than lifting off. After his gyrocopter malfunctioned and crashed into the southeastern shores of the Loch, Bingles survived the impact intact, but his machine shattered into scattered parts. Stranded far from Ironforge, he remains huddled near the wreckage, guarded against hungry crocolisks and hostile troggs while pleading with passing travelers to recover the tools and Blastencapper explosives that troggs from a nearby island stole from him.

npc:bink.text: Bink. Bink is a gnome mage trainer who resides within the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. Quick-witted and enthusiastic, she guides aspiring spellcasters through the intricacies of the arcane arts and connects them with prominent wizards across the Alliance. Located in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, Bink stands among the gathered scholars, priests, and arcanists in the Hall of Mysteries. Like many gnomes driven from Gnomeregan, she has adapted to life within the dwarven mountain stronghold, offering her keen intellect and knowledge of arcane craft to those learning the path of the mage. She is well connected to wizards across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, regularly pointing promising apprentices toward greater mentors such as High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind or Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

npc:bishop-delavey.text: Bishop DeLavey. Bishop DeLavey is a senior representative of the Church of the Holy Light stationed within the Petitioner's Chamber in Stormwind Keep. Acting on matters of state and faith, he quietly oversees sensitive court affairs that the Crown cannot publicly address. While Archbishop Benedictus tends to the Cathedral of Light, Bishop DeLavey resides among the nobility and petitioners of Stormwind Keep. He serves as an ecclesiastical liaison to the court, balancing spiritual counsel with the kingdom's political reality. His position allows him to hear whispered rumors and delicate palace grievances before they ever reach the ears of Highlord Bolvar Fordragon or the young King Anduin.

npc:bloodmage-lynnore.text: Bloodmage Lynnore. Bloodmage Lynnore is a blood elf practitioner of forbidden blood magic camped with her brother Drazial near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands. She assists adventurers by concocting potent alchemical draughts from the organs of local beasts. Camped near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands alongside her brother Drazial, Bloodmage Lynnore is one of the exceptionally rare elven practitioners of blood magic found in the Eastern Kingdoms. Unperturbed by the harsh and corrupting landscape of the Blasted Lands, she studies the latent arcane and vital energies coursing through native beasts. Travelers who bring her the brains and gizzards of local fauna find that she can distill these gruesome reagents into specialized elixirs granting profound enhancements to intellect and spirit.

npc:bluff-runner-windstrider.text: Bluff Runner Windstrider. Bluff Runner Windstrider is a wandering tauren messenger roaming the mesas of Thunder Bluff. He carries urgent dispatches across the city, directing Horde adventurers toward distant frontiers like Ashenvale, Feralas, and the Plaguelands. Thunder Bluff's soaring plateaus require swift feet to keep its leaders and visitors informed, and Bluff Runner Windstrider fills that vital role. Continually jogging the rope bridges and pathways of the tauren capital, he acts as a town crier and dispatch runner. When key outposts across Kalimdor or the Eastern Kingdoms require reinforcements, Windstrider flags down passing champions to carry word and take up the call to arms. Windstrider's dispatches range far beyond Mulgore's serene borders. He directs adventurers northward into Ashenvale to join Senani Thunderheart's great hunt at Splintertree Post, points hardened scouts south toward Camp Mojache in deep Feralas, and relays grave warnings regarding the ongoing undead menace in the Western Plaguelands. Through him, the tribal heart of Mulgore stays bound to the wider conflicts of the Horde.

npc:braelyn-firehand.text: Braelyn Firehand. Braelyn Firehand is an elusive elf residing quietly among the Horde at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. While presenting herself as an arcane practitioner seeking to clear mystical obstructions in the highlands, she pursues a deep personal grudge against the grove keepers of Stonetalon Peak. Standing out amidst the tauren lodges and rustic orcish tents of Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand is a rare sight: a blood elf dwelling openly within a remote Horde settlement. The shaman and chieftains of the retreat tolerate her presence, seemingly oblivious to her true loyalties. Braelyn presents herself as an observer fascinated by the flow of regional magic, eager to hire passing Horde mercenaries to handle dangerous field assignments across the crags.

npc:braenna-flintcrag.text: Braenna Flintcrag. Braenna Flintcrag is a dwarven priest trainer stationed within the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. She instructs devout followers of the Holy Light, guiding dwarven acolytes as they develop their spiritual disciplines and healing arts. She also passes word to visiting night elf priests when they are called home to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Residing within the quiet alcoves of the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Braenna Flintcrag serves the Alliance as a dedicated priest trainer. While Ironforge is renowned for its roaring forges and martial warriors, devout dwarves like Braenna tend to the spiritual welfare of Khaz Modan. She mentors novices answering the call of the Holy Light, teaching the dual disciplines of restorative mending and defensive warding required to survive in an increasingly dangerous world.

npc:brainwashed-noble.text: Brainwashed Noble. The Brainwashed Noble is an elusive, captive aristocrat found deep within the subterranean caverns outside the Deadmines in Westfall. Stripped of his autonomy through magical manipulation, he serves the Defias Brotherhood alongside undead minions rather than walking the grand halls of Stormwind. Wandering the murky, bone-littered passages leading into the Deadmines, the Brainwashed Noble presents a jarring contrast to the desperate bandits and rotting corpses that surround him. Clad in remnants of highborn finery, he was almost certainly a sitting member or scion of Stormwind's House of Nobles before falling into Edwin VanCleef's hands. Rather than ransom him for gold, the Defias have bent his mind with enchantments, turning a member of the ruling class into a spellcasting guard for their secret sanctuary. His tragic presence speaks volumes about the lengths the Brotherhood will go to inflict revenge upon the peers who refused to pay them.

npc:brandur-ironhammer.text: Brandur Ironhammer. Brandur Ironhammer is a dwarven paladin trainer residing in the Hall of Mysteries within Ironforge. He guides aspiring champions of the Holy Light through their early rites, testing their devotion and dispatching them across the Alliance. Stationed within the quiet alcoves of the Hall of Mysteries, Brandur Ironhammer serves the Alliance by instructing novice paladins in the ways of the Holy Light. Alongside his peer, Tiza Battleforge, Brandur keeps a watchful eye on young dwarven champions, guiding them through the trials of the Tome of Divinity. While deeply committed to his holy duties, he has acknowledged personal flaws under Tiza's frank counsel, working diligently to temper his envy and maintain the inner purity demanded of a warrior of the Light. Brandur serves as an essential liaison between Ironforge and the wider Alliance brotherhood. When human initiates find their way into the dwarven mountain, he redirects them back south to Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light. As paladins grow seasoned in the field, Brandur coordinates their deployment to battlegrounds such as Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands, eventually sending veteran crusaders to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker to undertake the demanding trials of the war charger.

npc:brann-bronzebeard.text: Brann Bronzebeard. Brann Bronzebeard is the youngest brother of King Magni and Muradin, who is believed dead, renowned throughout Azeroth as a peerless explorer, archaeologist, and founding leader of the Explorers' League. Driven by an insatiable curiosity for titan ruins and ancient history, his wanderlust has led him deep into the deadly wastes of Silithus. His field companions in southern Silithus await news of his latest expedition. While his eldest brother Magni rules Ironforge from the throne and Muradin served on battlefield frontlines, Brann took to the open wilds. He was a veteran warrior of the Second War. Yet peacetime turned his formidable constitution toward uncovering the forgotten past. As a leader of the Explorers' League, Brann charted vast swathes of the Eastern Kingdoms—from Elwynn Forest to the untamed jungles of Zul'Gurub—before turning his gaze across the Great Sea to the mysteries of ancient Kalimdor.

npc:branstock-khalder.text: Branstock Khalder. Branstock Khalder is the priest trainer stationed at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. Friendly and grounded, he introduces novice dwarven priests to the Holy Light while keeping a watchful eye on the growing trogg threat outside. Inside the bustling hall of Anvilmar, Branstock Khalder serves as a patient mentor to aspiring priests embarking on their spiritual journey. An easy-going dwarf with a deep devotion to the Light, he helps new acolytes master their early prayers and sacred runes. While his primary duty is spiritual instruction, Branstock is acutely aware of the valley's mounting perils—most notably the aggressive trogg infestation menacing the local mountaineers. Once a novice demonstrates sufficient command of the Light, he directs them through Coldridge Pass to seek further guidance from his superior, Maxan Anvol, in Kharanos.

npc:brave-moonhorn.text: Brave Moonhorn. Brave Moonhorn is a tauren scout stationed at the top of the Great Lift on the southern border of the Barrens. From this precipice, he keeps watch over the entry to Thousand Needles and alerts travelers to the local dangers ahead. Perched above the sheer drops of Thousand Needles, Brave Moonhorn stands guard where the northern plains meet the canyonlands. His primary role is keeping watchful eyes on regional threats moving through the canyon floor below, particularly the hostile centaur clans. Anyone looking to descend into the needles often crosses paths with him first, receiving crucial warnings before they step onto the massive platforms of the Great Lift. Beyond the constant threat of roving centaur, Moonhorn harbors deep misgivings about his fellow tauren from the Grimtotem tribe. He cautions traveling Horde allies to keep their distance from them, noting their increasingly erratic and suspicious behavior around Thousand Needles. To ensure the defense of the region, he dispatches couriers to Freewind Post to deliver warnings to Cliffwatcher Longhorn.

npc:brewmeister-bilger.text: Brewmeister Bilger. Brewmeister Bilger is an intoxicated dwarven brewer residing in the cellar of the inn at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He whiles away his hours tasting potent spirits and waiting on deliveries from distant lands. Bilger spends his days pacing the cool cellar beneath Southshore's inn, nursing hiccups and seeking out the strongest brews Azeroth can offer. Despite his perpetual stupor, Bilger remains a discerning judge of spirits. He maintains an appetite for heavy dwarven moonshines and potent liquors crafted in the south, eagerly receiving special batches like the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends him from the Thandol Span.

npc:brock-stoneseeker.text: Brock Stoneseeker. Brock Stoneseeker is a dwarven mining instructor based in the settlement of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. As the proprietor of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying, he instructs novice prospectors in the craft of extracting valuable ores and minerals from the earth. Operating out of Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker directs Brock's School of Mining and Surveying. In the mineral-rich hills of Loch Modan, seasoned expertise with a pickaxe and an eye for geological veins are indispensable. Brock guides aspiring miners through the foundational techniques of identifying ore nodes, extracting raw metals, and properly surveying subterranean deposits, ensuring Alliance tradesfolk can fuel Ironforge's legendary smithies.

npc:bromos-grummner.text: Bromos Grummner. Bromos Grummner is a dwarven paladin trainer stationed in Anvilmar within Coldridge Valley. He mentors fledgling dwarven holy warriors, preaching steadfast faith in the Holy Light and the vital bond between dwarves and humans in the Knights of the Silver Hand. Standing within the sturdy stone hall of Anvilmar, Bromos Grummner welcomes dwarven novices drawn to the discipline of the Holy Light. Confident and resolute, he instructs young paladins in martial rites and sacred invocations. Beyond the basic tenets of combat, Bromos emphasizes unity, reminding his pupils that the order of the Knights of the Silver Hand bridges the realms of Ironforge and the human kingdoms of the Alliance in righteous purpose.

npc:brother-joshua.text: Brother Joshua. Brother Joshua is a human priest of the Church of the Holy Light stationed within the grand Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Dedicated to guiding the faithful, he trains novice priests in channeling the Holy Light to mend wounds and bolster their allies. His quiet service anchors the day-to-day spiritual instruction carried out in the heart of the kingdom. Within the serene halls of the Cathedral of Light, Brother Joshua stands near the main altar, ready to instruct newly called servants of the faith. As a priest trainer for the Church of the Holy Light, Joshua provides instruction on the foundational disciplines of healing, protective wards, and the spiritual focus required to commune with the Light. For young human priests starting their service to the Alliance, he represents one of their first guides into deeper communion with the divine.

npc:brother-kristoff.text: Brother Kristoff. Brother Kristoff is a human member of the Church of the Holy Light stationed in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. He can be found standing outdoors near the grand statue of Uther the Lightbringer. Preoccupied with theological study, he frequently seeks out practical literature to weave into sermons on spiritual strength. Brother Kristoff serves the Church of the Holy Light from the open courtyard of Cathedral Square, lingering in the shadow of the great monument to Uther the Lightbringer. Unlike some clerics who remain secluded within the marble cloisters of the Cathedral of Light, Kristoff works among the citizens and pilgrims passing through the plaza. In preparing his discourses—such as sermons on the Fortitude of the Spirit—he draws upon grounded, worldly analogies. He famously looks to technical treatises like 'The Stresses of Iron' to explain how the mortal soul endures pressure, comparing the inner resolve granted by the Holy Light to the tempered strength of worked metal.

npc:brother-neals.text: Brother Neals. Brother Neals is a monk residing in Northshire Abbey within Elwynn Forest. Responsible for managing the abbey's stores of food and drink, he spends much of his time overseeing shipments and sampling the vintage produced by the local vineyard. Tucked away in the upper belfry rooms of Northshire Abbey, Brother Neals looks after the monastery's culinary provisions and beverage stores. He takes a particular, enthusiastic interest in the Northshire vineyards, carefully tracking grape manifests and ensuring the quality of the abbey's renowned wine by tasting it with dedicated frequency. Despite the peaceful duties of inventory and cellar management, he keeps close tabs on the shipments arriving from the valley's surrounding fields.

npc:brother-sarno.text: Brother Sarno. Brother Sarno is an affable human cleric stationed at the entrance of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. Serving as the primary greeter for worshipers and visitors, he also helps direct brave Alliance travelers toward engineers in Ironforge who need aid in reclaiming Gnomeregan. Standing just inside the archways of Stormwind's magnificent Cathedral of Light, Brother Sarno is often the very first face pilgrims and travelers encounter. As a dedicated brother of the Church of the Holy Light, his role is simple yet vital: offering a kind greeting to anyone who enters the sacred hall seeking solace, prayer, or guidance. His warmth extends even to the most unexpected visitors, making him a reassuring presence amid the city's busy clerical life. Beyond his pastoral greetings, Brother Sarno maintains communication with allies across the Alliance. When Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge urgently needed assistance dealing with his rogue invention, Techbot, deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan, Sarno took it upon himself to guide capable adventurers toward Dun Morogh. Though a humble brother of the cloth, he understands that supporting the displaced gnomes is an act of genuine fraternity.

npc:brother-wilhelm.text: Brother Wilhelm. Brother Wilhelm is a human paladin trainer stationed in Goldshire within Elwynn Forest. Tucked away behind the village blacksmith, he instructs young defenders of the Holy Light taking their first steps outside Northshire Abbey. While Northshire Valley provides initial shelter for fledgling champions of the Light, those stepping into the broader world of Elwynn Forest often seek out Brother Wilhelm. Stationed just behind the busy smithy in Goldshire, he trains newly minted paladins in their sacred duties, providing guidance and lessons as they transition from abbey novices to sworn protectors of the realm. Wilhelm plays a crucial role in directing aspiring paladins along their holy journey, helping them seek out the Tome of Divinity. Through this vital rite, initiates learn the weight of sacrifice and the power of divine redemption, testing their devotion so they may wield the Light to resurrect fallen comrades and uphold justice across the Kingdom of Stormwind.

npc:cain-firesong.text: Cain Firesong. Cain Firesong is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. He assists fledgling practitioners of the arcane as they grow in power, guiding them before directing them onward to deeper studies in the Undercity. He can be found on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern. While many Forsaken spellcasters delve into shadow or necromancy, Cain Firesong maintains mastery over traditional arcane disciplines. Stationed in Brill, he serves as an early mentor to Forsaken mages venturing forth from Deathknell. The local Deathguards direct visitors to the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern, joking that he arrived too late to get a room. As novice mages under his tutelage advance beyond their preliminary studies in Tirisfal Glades, Cain ensures they do not stagnate. He directs his most capable students to seek out Anastasia Hartwell, a master sorceress residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

npc:calvin-montague.text: Calvin Montague. Calvin Montague is an opportunistic Forsaken rogue loitering near the exit gate of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Preying on newly awakened undead as they leave the graveyard, he attempts to trick passersby into running errands on his behalf. Positioned just outside the gates leading away from Deathknell, Calvin Montague embodies the ruthless pragmatism common among Lordaeron's restless dead. Rather than handling his own correspondence or paying fair courier rates, he attempts to smooth-talk wandering adventurers into delivering letters under false pretenses. While several other prominent undead bearing the Montague family name manage banking interests within the Undercity, Calvin pursues a decidedly less reputable trade, preferring petty schemes and deception.

npc:captain-danuvin.text: Captain Danuvin. Captain Danuvin is an officer stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall, serving as one of the leaders tasked with holding the frontier together. Working alongside the People's Militia, he directs volunteers and recruits to patrol the roads and push back against encroaching Gnolls and outlaws. His commands are vital to keeping the supply lines and farmlands from falling completely into hostile hands. Perched at the fortified tower of Sentinel Hill, Captain Danuvin coordinates ground patrols across Westfall. The region has spiraled into chaos with the withdrawal of regular Stormwind garrison troops, leaving local defenses severely depleted. Danuvin relies heavily on wandering adventurers, local farmhands, and volunteer fighters to maintain even a semblance of order across the grassy plains. Danuvin's immediate strategic concern is the security of the roadways and open lands around Sentinel Hill. With the Riverpaw Gnolls growing bolder and raiding close to central outposts, he organizes active patrols to cull their packs and secure the perimeter. His orders help prevent the encampment from being entirely surrounded by Westfall's opportunists and marauders.

npc:captain-rugelfuss.text: Captain Rugelfuss. Captain Rugelfuss is a stern dwarven officer stationed at the southern gate in the Valley of Kings. Tasked with securing the border of Loch Modan, he organizes the defense against a sudden and aggressive trogg uprising. Positioned near the monumental carved arches of the Valley of Kings, Captain Rugelfuss oversees the southern gateway into Loch Modan. With Alliance forces stretched thin across the world, Ironforge relies on veteran officers like him to keep the home territories secure. Rugelfuss dismisses military pomp and formalities, preferring to focus entirely on the grim reality facing the border. The primary crisis demanding Rugelfuss's attention is the swelling trogg threat. Unearthed from ancient caverns and surging into the highlands, these savage brutes have overwhelmed outlying dwarven patrols and established fortified footholds nearby. Under the banner of defending the King's lands, the captain recruits capable travelers to cull their ranks and push the creatures back from the roadway.

npc:captain-shatterskull.text: Captain Shatterskull. Captain Shatterskull is a seasoned orc commander stationed at the Mor'shan Base Camp on the northern frontier of the Barrens. Serving as a crucial bulwark for the Horde, he coordinates efforts to repulse night elf forces contesting the border near Warsong Gulch. Positioned at Mor'shan Base Camp along the edge of Ashenvale, Captain Shatterskull serves on the front lines of the Horde's territorial clashes. Beside fellow officers like Kadrak, Shatterskull works to maintain the Horde's foothold against night elf sentinels and Silverwing forces striving to reclaim the borderlands. His post demands relentless vigilance, as the conflict over Ashenvale's timber and ancient lands constantly threatens to spill over into the Barrens.

npc:captain-thalo-thas-brightsun.text: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun. Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun is a privateer affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel, stationed at the docks of Ratchet. Despite keeping a cordial demeanor toward traveling Alliance members, he harbors intense resentment toward the Theramore forces at Northwatch Hold who dare fire upon his vessels. Operating out of the bustling neutral port of Ratchet, Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun leads the Thalo'dan Privateers under the broad banner of the Steamwheedle Cartel. In theory, Ratchet's merchants welcome all flags so long as their coin is good, but maritime trade along the Barrens coast is fraught with danger. Just south of the port lies Northwatch Hold, an aggressive Alliance fortification whose heavy artillery threatens neutral sea lanes. Brightsun maintains an outward neutrality toward visiting travelers, but he has reached his limit with the belligerent garrison firing on his fleet. Because full-scale conflict would endanger Ratchet's neutrality, Brightsun cannot deploy an open armada against the fortress. Instead, he looks to capable Horde mercenaries to settle the score. He discreetly arranges strikes against Northwatch Hold to silence the fortress's cannons and secure the freedom of his captured crew. By employing Horde auxiliaries rather than provoking a direct Alliance retaliation against the cartel, Brightsun protects his shipping interests while keeping Ratchet's official ledger clean.

npc:captured-mountaineer.text: Captured Mountaineer. The Captured Mountaineer is an Ironforge dwarf held prisoner in the basement of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Bound and guarded by the Forsaken, he serves as an unwilling subject for the Royal Apothecary Society's grim experiments. Tucked away beneath the floorboards of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, this Ironforge Mountaineer sits captive far from the safety of Khaz Modan. While patrons drink above, the Royal Apothecary Society puts him to work as an unwitting test subject for their concoctions. Apothecary Johaan and his peers test the lethal potency of their developing plague against living Alliance physiology, using the prisoner to gauge how well their toxins bring a swift and agonizing end to the living.

npc:captured-scarlet-zealot.text: Captured Scarlet Zealot. The Captured Scarlet Zealot is a crusader prisoner held captive in the basement of Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Watched over by Forsaken apothecaries and townsfolk, he serves as a living test subject for the Royal Apothecary Society's developing concoctions. Confined beneath Gallows' End Tavern, this member of the Scarlet Crusade embodies the unyielding fanaticism of his order. Even in chains, surrounded by the undead he views as an abomination, he offers no remorse, calling on the Light to protect him from the foul and unholy creatures around him. For the Forsaken, capturing a living zealot is not an act of mercy; it provides valuable human test material to evaluate the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development by Apothecary Johaan.

npc:caretaker-folsom.text: Caretaker Folsom. Caretaker Folsom is a somber human servant found along the Canals of Stormwind City near the Park. Once the trusted overseer of the noble Flintridge family's estate, he now handles the bitter remnants of their tragic downfall. Like his father before him, Folsom devoted his life to serving the Flintridge family as their estate caretaker. That quiet life of service came to a bloody end with the massacre of the Flintridge household. With the bloodline wiped out, the manor sat abandoned until its remaining funds completely dried up. Left alone to oversee the remnants of the household, Folsom bears the sorrowful duty of liquidating the family's surviving heirlooms and possessions at auction.

npc:carolai-anise.text: Carolai Anise. Carolai Anise is an eccentric Forsaken alchemist residing in the village of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. She trains novice alchemists, though her hazardous concoctions have drawn nervous murmurs from local guards. Operating out of Brill, Carolai Anise devotes her unlife to the volatile art of alchemy. While many Forsaken researchers operate under the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate, Carolai pursues her own strange brews right inside the settlement. Her unpredictable experiments and smoking retorts are notorious enough that the Deathguards keeping watch over Brill openly grumble that she seems bent on blowing up her own house.

npc:cazul.text: Cazul. Cazul is an ancient, blind orc warlock dwelling in the darkened cavern of the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. Despite having lost his physical sight, he possesses profound occult insight and guides rising practitioners of the dark arts seeking to expand their demonic command. Tucked away in the cavernous depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Cazul endures as a relic of old warlock traditions. Though entirely blind, his senses are attuned to the shifting currents of the Twisting Nether and the whispers of demonic entities. Rising warlocks are often directed to him when seeking to expand their mastery and bind more dangerous servitors. His sharp awareness and occult wisdom make it clear that losing his eyes cost him nothing of his arcane power.

npc:cerellean-whiteclaw.text: Cerellean Whiteclaw. Cerellean Whiteclaw is a night elf resting near the docks and inn of Auberdine in Darkshore. Haunted by the memory of his lost love from the ancient Sundering, he struggles to lay her restless spirit to peace. Ten thousand years ago, prior to the War of the Ancients, Cerellean Whiteclaw shared his life with Anaya Dawnrunner. When the demonic invasion tore ancient Kalimdor apart, Anaya perished in the destruction of her city, Ameth'Aran. Stricken with grief, Cerellean followed Malfurion Stormrage into the long druidic slumber, yet the Emerald Dream offered him little respite from her memory. Upon awakening millennia later, he wandered Darkshore in a grief-stricken haze, only to discover that Anaya's ghost remained bound to the very stones where she fell.

npc:chef-breanna.text: Chef Breanna. Chef Breanna is the head cook at Lakeshire's local dining house in the Redridge Mountains. Tasked with feeding the garrison of Stormwind soldiers stationed to protect the embattled lakeside town, she relies on hearty, local ingredients to keep the defenders on their feet. Operating out of a restaurant house in northwestern Lakeshire alongside her assistants Crystal Boughman and Gretchen Vogel, Chef Breanna bears the heavy responsibility of provisioning the entire local battalion. With Lakeshire besieged by Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs, maintaining the strength and morale of Stormwind's understaffed garrison is essential. Her signature dish, Redridge Goulash, relies on the wild game and beasts roaming the surrounding ridges, turning dangerous wilderness predators into fuel for the town's weary guard.

npc:chef-grual.text: Chef Grual. Chef Grual is the resident cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. In a secluded town choked by mist and monsters, Grual does his best to keep the Night Watch and weary travelers fed, even if his choice of ingredients raises eyebrows. Running an eatery in Darkshire is a grim task. With supply lines from Westfall and Stormwind constantly harassed by highwaymen, wolves, and undead, fresh provisions are virtually nonexistent. Grual makes do with whatever the wilderness provides. From wolf flank to whatever scavenged meats local adventurers drag through the door, Grual cooks with pragmatism born of necessity. Grual is infamous for his specialty dishes, most notably his famous 'Dusky Crab Cakes' and seasoned wolf kabobs. Given that coastal crabs are nowhere near the gloomy inland woods of Duskwood, his crab cakes rely on a rather revolting substitute: the gooey legs of local Venom Web Spiders. Whether patrons realize they are eating arachnid meat or simply prefer not to ask, Grual keeps the kitchen running without apologies.

npc:chef-jessen.text: Chef Jessen. Chef Jessen is Southshore's resident meat vendor and culinarian, working to keep the coastal town fed amidst constant border tensions. He is best remembered for his famous turtle bisque. Operating out of Southshore in the southern Hillsbrad Foothills, Chef Jessen provides provisions and meat to locals and visiting Alliance soldiers alike. He possesses notable culinary expertise. Years past, before plague and war disrupted northern Lordaeron, he regularly ventured north past Dalaran to the shores of Lordamere Lake. There, he harvested meat from native snapjaw turtles to concoct his prized Soothing Turtle Bisque, a hearty recipe he is willing to share with aspiring travelers who assist him in gathering ingredients.

npc:chief-archaeologist-greywhisker.text: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker is an emissary of the dwarven Explorers' League stationed in Darnassus outside the Temple of the Moon. Sent from Ironforge across the sea to northern Kalimdor, he seeks to uncover ancient history and coordinates dwarven field research throughout the region. Currently, he is preoccupied with gathering field reports and tracking lost colleagues operating in Darkshore. While it is unusual to find an Ironforge dwarf nestled high in the boughs of Teldrassil, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker represents the far-reaching ambitions of the Explorers' League. Having traded the lecture halls and museum vaults of Ironforge for fieldwork in Kalimdor, he can be found standing outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, conferring with local night elf scholars such as Tarelvir. Greywhisker's academic lectures back in the Eastern Kingdoms famously touched upon ancient lore and primordial entities like the Wild God Agamaggan, and he is eager to see what ancient secrets the night elves' ancestral lands might hold. Greywhisker's primary role in Kalimdor is to oversee dwarven excavations and keep tabs on expeditions scouring ancient ruins along the coast. Unfortunately for the chief archaeologist, field research in unexplored lands comes with distinct perils. He relies on passing travelers to establish communication with prospectors stationed across the sea in Darkshore, anxiously awaiting news from dig sites and hoping his colleagues haven't succumbed to the dangers lurking among ancient ruins.

npc:christoph-jeffcoat.text: Christoph Jeffcoat. Christoph Jeffcoat is a Forsaken merchant stationed in the settlement of Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. He supplies local crafters and travelers with essential trade goods, cooking seasonings, and specialty recipes. In an active war zone contested by the Alliance and the Syndicate, his mundane wares keep the northern Horde war effort running. While Tarren Mill stands as the Forsaken's military stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills, a garrison cannot fight on malice alone. Christoph Jeffcoat handles the quiet, practical side of occupation, vending reagents, tools, threads, and spices to soldiers and traveling artisans. From the soothing spices required for local culinary recipes like turtle bisque to rare schematics and alchemical vials, Jeffcoat ensures that Horde forces passing through southern Lordaeron are fully provisioned for the battles against Southshore and the regional perils.

npc:chronormu.text: Chronormu. Chronormu, who goes by the mortal name Chromie, is a bronze dragon disguised as an energetic female gnome. Tasked with safeguarding the flow of time on Azeroth, she often works directly with mortals rather than observing from afar. In the Western Plaguelands, she quietly intervenes in the tragic aftermath of the Third War to right disrupted temporal threads. Though she appears to mortals as an eccentric and cheerful gnome named Chromie, Chronormu is a member of the bronze dragonflight serving under the Timeless One, Nozdormu. Bronze dragons are charged by the titans with guarding history and correcting disruptions in the timeways. In the form of a female gnome, she walks beside mortals as an approachable, optimistic peer. Chronormu has taken up residence within the ruined ruins of Lordaeron, particularly watching the devastated Western Plaguelands. The catastrophic downfall of the kingdom and the spread of the Scourge tore deeply into the region's history, leaving temporal anomalies and trapped remnants. Working discreetly from places like the ruins of Andorhal, she enlists mortal adventurers to mend tangled timelines and investigate disturbances without revealing the full terrifying majesty of the dragonflight unless necessary.

npc:clarice-foster.text: Clarice Foster. Clarice Foster is a Forsaken woman residing deep beneath the bluffs of Mulgore within the Pools of Vision. Far from the plagued glades of Lordaeron, she spends her days in contemplation among the tauren seers and mystics. While most Forsaken remain in the northern lands of Lordaeron rebuilding their kingdom under the Undercity, Clarice Foster has traveled to the heart of the tauren lands in Kalimdor. Sheltered within the cavernous Pools of Vision beneath the mesa of Thunder Bluff, she dwells alongside Forsaken apothecaries and tauren shamans who study the spiritual and elemental mysteries of the earth.

npc:colonel-kurzen.text: Colonel Kurzen. Colonel Conrad Kurzen was once a decorated and noble officer of the Stormwind Army, sent to lead an expedition into northern Stranglethorn Vale. After descending into sudden madness and tyranny, he turned his force into a rogue jungle militia operating out of an armed compound. Today, his former subordinates at the nearby Rebel Camp actively seek his death to end his reign of terror. Before his downfall, Colonel Conrad Kurzen was regarded in Stormwind as an exceptionally capable and noble officer. Trusted by the kingdom's leadership, he was granted command of an expeditionary unit dispatched south into the dense jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. However, deep within the humid wilds, Kurzen began to exhibit erratic behavior and extreme megalomania, declaring absolute sovereignty over the surrounding wilderness and abandoning his allegiance to Stormwind. Kurzen's sudden transformation divided his ranks. While many soldiers succumbed to blind loyalty or twisted zealotry, others grew appalled by his madness and brutality—including his act of throwing Emerine Junis into the compound's prison simply for spurning his advances. Led by Lieutenant Doren, a group of conscience-stricken soldiers broke away to establish the Rebel Camp along the northern road. These loyalist defectors now wage a desperate war against Kurzen to stop his rampaging force.

npc:commander-mar-alith.text: Commander Mar'alith. Commander Mar'alith is the stalwart night elf military commander directing the Cenarion Circle's vanguard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. Clad in heavy armor and wielding a grand glaive, he coordinates the martial resistance against the silithid swarms and Twilight's Hammer cultists. Beneath his resolute leadership lies a deep personal sorrow regarding the mysterious fate of his beloved wife, Natalia. Stationed at the heart of Cenarion Hold, Commander Mar'alith bears the tremendous responsibility of safeguarding the Circle's desert bastion. While the druids unravel the ancient ecological and cosmic anomalies of Silithus, Mar'alith handles the grim, practical necessities of war. He oversees tactical strikes against the bustling silithid hives of Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal, ensuring that the relentless insectoid incursions do not overwhelm the expedition's central foothold. Despite his stern military bearing, Mar'alith is visibly strained by a harrowing personal tragedy. His beloved wife, Natalia Mar'alith, ventured into the shifting sands on an assignment for the Circle and failed to return. Caught between his duty to the Cenarion expedition and agonizing grief, the commander appears increasingly distracted, clinging to whatever hope remains while desperate for news of what truly became of her in the wastes.

npc:councilman-millstipe.text: Councilman Millstipe. Councilman Millstipe is a member of Darkshire's governing council, residing within the town hall of Duskwood. Deeply resentful of royal neglect and judicial meddling from the capital, he actively seeks retribution against criminals who endanger the darkened region. While Darkshire struggles under the shadow of the undead and ferocious beast attacks, its local council fights an uphill battle against the bureaucracy of Stormwind City. Councilman Millstipe represents the town's growing bitterness toward the crown. When the notorious grave robber Dextren Ward was caught selling freshly dug corpses to the necromancer Morbent Fel, Darkshire's leaders sentenced him to death. Instead, Stormwind's House of Nobles intervened, commuting Ward's execution and locking him safely away inside the Stormwind Stockade.

npc:count-remington-ridgewell.text: Count Remington Ridgewell. Count Remington Ridgewell is a wealthy human aristocrat found in the Petitioner's Chamber within Stormwind Keep. As a member of the House of Nobles, he prides himself on curating the finest private collection of rare historical artifacts, heirlooms, and fine art in the kingdom. Remington Ridgewell represents the elite tastes of the House of Nobles, taking immense pride in his family's personal museum of jewelry and artifacts. Rather than concerning himself with military campaigns or local uprisings, the Count spends his considerable wealth acquiring relics from fallen civilizations and fallen houses across Azeroth. To expand his prestigious gallery, he finances daring adventurers and employs field agents such as Mayara Brightwing, dispatching them to retrieve priceless oddities from perilous ruins, from the mountain redoubts of Alterac to the volcanic wastes of the Burning Steppes.

npc:crane-operator-bigglefuzz.text: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz. Crane Operator Bigglefuzz is a goblin dockhand working the heavy machinery at the port of Ratchet. After an overloaded crane mishap scattered cargo across the docks, he finds himself desperate to recover a valuable stolen bottle before his superiors notice. Like many goblin dockworkers, Crane Operator Bigglefuzz prioritized efficiency and haste over basic safety margins. While attempting to hoist an excessively heavy haul from a merchant vessel, his crane buckled, sending crates crashing down across the Ratchet wharves. In the ensuing chaos, opportunistic scoundrels swept in, leaving Bigglefuzz to scramble to clean up the mess and salvage the most precious goods before Gazlowe or the local port masters dock his pay. The worst casualty of the accident was not the broken wood, but a crate containing rare ninety-nine-year-old port. Before Bigglefuzz could secure the spill, an elusive vagrant named Mad Magglish snatched a bottle and fled into hiding, threatening to leave Bigglefuzz answering for an irreplaceable loss.

npc:craven-drok.text: Craven Drok. Craven Drok is a wandering orc found skulking in the dimly lit tunnels of the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. True to his moniker, he keeps to the dark corners of the city, occasionally reaching out to travelers willing to help with a delicate matter: how the Alliance sees the Horde. While most orcs of Orgrimmar proudly walk the sunlit avenues of the Valley of Honor or the Valley of Strength, Craven Drok avoids the daylight entirely. He haunts the winding, subterranean paths of the Cleft of Shadow, an enclave typically reserved for warlocks, rogues, and practitioners of less honorable trades. Drok lives up to his cowardly reputation, preferring to stay out of sight while hiring passersby to carry out his discreet errands, including an errand concerning the Horde's standing with the Alliance.

npc:cyrus-therepentous.text: Cyrus Therepentous. Cyrus Therepentous is a formidable black dragonspawn residing in the cavernous depths of Slither Rock in the Burning Steppes. Rather than immediately striking down intruders, he tests daring mortals to see if they possess the strength to serve the purposes of the Black dragonflight. Secluded inside a cavern at Slither Rock, Cyrus Therepentous oversees the volcanic crags of the Burning Steppes. Like many of his kind, he views mortal travelers with immense condescension, declaring that only fools would disturb his lair. Yet beneath his ferocious exterior lies a cold calculation: rather than consuming every trespasser on sight, he offers them a lethal challenge against his minions, willing to exploit those resilient enough to survive the trials of flame.

npc:dark-cleric-beryl.text: Dark Cleric Beryl. Dark Cleric Beryl is a Forsaken priest trainer stationed in the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. He guides newly awakened undead priests as they learn to wield shadow magic and adapt to their new, unholy existence under the Dark Lady. Residing on the upper floor of the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, Dark Cleric Beryl serves the Forsaken by mentoring nascent priests. Beryl teaches that a Forsaken priest's power comes from darkness and shadow, yet one must also know the light before mastering the dark. He assists newly risen practitioners as they turn their focus toward shadow and the dark arts, guiding them through early trials like crafting their Garments of Darkness and proving their dedication to the new path.

npc:darkmaster-gandling.text: Darkmaster Gandling. Darkmaster Gandling is the mortal headmaster of Scholomance, overseeing the instruction and training of necromancers for the Cult of the Damned. Operating from the depths of the ruined Keep of Caer Darrow, he serves the Scourge by orchestrating gruesome magical experiments upon the living and dead alike. Within the dark halls beneath Caer Darrow, Darkmaster Gandling governs Scholomance, the premier academy for the Scourge's aspiring necromancers. A living human serving the Cult of the Damned, Gandling worked alongside the lich Ras Frostwhisper to orchestrate atrocities against countless innocent captives taken from the surrounding lands. Students who enter his classrooms are instructed in plague brewing, reanimation, and flesh sculpting. Residing deep within the Headmaster's Study, Gandling commands the dark relics and spirits trapped inside the ancient school.
