Perched on the snowy border where Coldridge Valley gives way to the deeper crags of Dun Morogh, Mountaineer Thalos serves as the first line of defense for travelers leaving the dwarven training grounds. Coldridge Pass has become a treacherous chokepoint overrun by hostile troggs who have burrowed up from the subterranean depths. Thalos stands vigil in the cold, warning the unready to turn back and assessing whether hardy couriers possess the grit to fight their way through to the wider kingdom. When Grelin Whitebeard finishes his report on the Frostmane troll movements within the secluded valley, the courier carrying it to his brother Senir in Kharanos is told to speak with Mountaineer Thalos before entering the tunnel. After verifying that an adventurer is capable of braving the infested passage, Thalos directs them onward to Kharanos, where regional commanders coordinate Dun Morogh's defense. His watchful presence ensures that vital intelligence reaches Ironforge's military leaders rather than dying in the snow.

npc:mupsi-shacklefridd.text: Mupsi Shacklefridd. Mupsi Shacklefridd is a goblin resident stationed just outside the port town of Ratchet in the Barrens. She serves as a local contact for travelers looking to smooth over troubled relations with the Steamwheedle Cartel. Mupsi Shacklefridd operates just outside Ratchet along the dusty coastal roads of the Barrens. Life near the port town is always busy, with Steamwheedle guards patrolling the perimeter and merchants coming and going. For those who find themselves in poor standing with the goblins, Mupsi provides a path to reconciliation—provided travelers are willing to offer the supplies and labor the cartel demands.

npc:mux-manascrambler.text: Mux Manascrambler. Mux Manascrambler is an eccentric goblin engineer dwelling in the desert outpost of Gadgetzan. Unlike many of his peers focused strictly on explosives or mining equipment, Mux harbors a peculiar fascination with the supernatural and occult energies. Tucked away inside a building in central Gadgetzan, behind Driz Plunkbow and his clanking Butcherbots, sits Mux Manascrambler. While the Steamwheedle Cartel trades heavily in oil, guns, and salvage, Mux focuses his ingenuity on more esoteric pursuits: the realm of spirits and supernatural anomalies. He uses his technical acumen to design bizarre devices capable of detecting, distilling, and interacting with spectral remnants, bridging crude goblin craftsmanship with the invisible worlds of the dead.

npc:mydrannul.text: Mydrannul. Mydrannul is a night elf general goods vendor stationed at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. He serves the capital's sentinels, soldiers, and visitors by keeping basic supplies, munitions, and provisions readily available. Located among the military pavilions and training grounds of the Warrior's Terrace, Mydrannul provides essential gear to Darnassus's defenders and traveling adventurers alike. His wares include the practical everyday items needed for life in the field: ammunition for archers and gunners, throwing blades, flint, pouches, and simple rations. By tending his stall in the city's martial district, he ensures that the sentinels and trainees preparing for duty on Teldrassil do not want for basic sundries.

npc:nalpak.text: Nalpak. Nalpak is a tauren druid disciple who watches over the troubled Wailing Caverns in the Barrens. Stationed in the high cliff-cave overlooking the cavern entrance, he enlists passing adventurers to help contain the nightmare twisting the subterranean ecosystem. Perched inside a hidden cavern directly above the mouth of the Wailing Caverns, Nalpak remains loyal to the vision of Naralex. While his master lies trapped in a corrupted slumber deep below, Nalpak works to keep the spreading corruption at bay. He asks adventurers to gather deviate hides for use as leather.

npc:nara-meideros.text: Nara Meideros. Nara Meideros is a night elf priestess stationed within the tranquil greenery of the Park in Stormwind City. Serving as a mentor to acolytes, she represents the teachings of Elune amidst the human capital. While most priestesses of Elune remain in Kalimdor under the boughs of Teldrassil, Nara Meideros resides far across the Great Sea in Stormwind City. Found within the Park—a haven nurtured by visiting night elf druids and priests—she guides young spiritual seekers in the ways of divine devotion. Alongside human practitioners of the Holy Light in Cathedral Square, Nara offers night elves visiting or living in the Eastern Kingdoms a familiar connection to the grace of the Moon Goddess.

npc:narain-soothfancy.text: Narain Soothfancy. Narain Soothfancy is an eccentric gnome dwelling in a secluded beach hut just north of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. While he loudly advertises himself as a master soothsayer capable of divining the future, those who know him consider his psychic talents a complete farce compared to his genuine engineering genius. Perched on the eastern coast of Tanaris just north of the goblin docks, Narain Soothfancy lives as a retired engineer turned self-proclaimed master fortune teller. He routinely greets visitors by pressing unopened envelopes against his forehead or making wildly inaccurate guesses about their business, such as wondering if they have arrived seeking the legendary Ashbringer. Despite his theatrical charade, Narain possesses deep technical knowledge. Even ancient beings like the blue dragon Azuregos note that while Narain is a terrible psychic, his engineering aptitude is undeniably brilliant. A handbook titled 'Soothsaying for Dummies' rests nearby. Before settling by Steamwheedle Port, Narain suffered a catastrophic flying machine crash far to the south along Land's End Beach. He survived the wreck thanks to an unexpected rescue, though his eccentric personality and strange obsessions have kept him isolated on the desert shores, tinkering with arcane-adjacent technology and peddling dubious prophecies to anyone who passes by.

npc:nat-pagle.text: Nat Pagle. Nat Pagle is widely hailed as the most renowned angler in all of Azeroth, despite claiming he only fishes as an excuse to drink heavily. He makes his home on a secluded inlet in Dustwallow Marsh, where he trains elite anglers from both the Alliance and the Horde who manage to prove their patience. Though his name is synonymous with angling mastery across the known world, Nat Pagle is remarkably casual about his craft. Having cast lines for several decades, he often admits he has no great reverence for the sport itself, famously calling it little more than a convenient excuse to sit back and drink heavily. Despite this gruff nonchalance, Nat understands aquatic life and the art of angling better than anyone alive, even licensing fishing gear sought out by professionals. Pagle makes his camp on a small spit of land along the eastern coast of Dustwallow Marsh, far from the bustling taverns of the Eastern Kingdoms. He remains fiercely independent and uninterested in the politics of factions, welcoming Alliance travelers sent by trainers like Grimnur Stonebrand as well as Horde aspirants directed to him by Lumak in Orgrimmar. For Nat, anyone willing to scour the corners of the world for rare specimens deserves a lesson in genuine angling. Pagle has ventured into perilous waters, including an excursion into the ruins of Zul'Gurub where he misplaced his favorite measuring tape and tackle box near the waters prowled by the monstrous hydra Gahz'ranka.

npc:natalia-mar-alith.text: Natalia Mar'alith. Mistress Natalia Mar'alith is a night elf priestess and Cenarion Circle researcher lost deep within the silithid nests of Hive'Regal. Once part of the expedition investigating Silithus alongside her husband, Commander Mar'alith, she has succumbed completely to the maddening influence of the Old Gods. When the Cenarion Circle established their outpost at Cenarion Hold to monitor the awakening sands, Natalia accompanied her husband, Commander Mar'alith, into the wastes. Eager to unravel the mystery behind the resurgence of the silithid and the ancient Qiraji ruins, she joined an exploratory party led by the famed explorer Brann Bronzebeard, accompanied by the dwarven researchers Rutgar Glyphshaper and Frankal Stonebridge.

npc:nathanos-blightcaller.text: Nathanos Blightcaller. Nathanos Blightcaller, once Nathanos Marris, stands at his ruined homestead in the Eastern Plaguelands as the deadly champion of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner. In life he was the first and only human Ranger Lord of Quel'Thalas, and in undeath he trains Forsaken hunters while guarding the eastern frontier with biting contempt for all who approach. Before the Third War, Nathanos Marris was an extraordinary marksman and tactical genius hailing from the rural outskirts of Lordaeron. Trained by the high elves of Quel'Thalas and close to Sylvanas Windrunner, he became the only human to ever attain the prestigious rank of Ranger Lord. His home remained the family estate in Lordaeron, the Marris Stead. When Prince Arthas and the Scourge swept through Lordaeron following the purge of Stratholme, the plague consumed the kingdom. Nathanos made a desperate stand at his estate, but fell to the monstrous abomination Ramstein the Gorger. Raised as a mindless undead thrall, he roamed the blighted fields killing in the Lich King's name. After Sylvanas shattered the Scourge's mental grip and established the Forsaken in the Undercity, she came for him, as he had somehow known she would, and tore his consciousness free from the Lich King's will, returning his tactical brilliance and fiery loyalty to her side.

npc:nida.text: Hilary. Hilary is a young human girl living in the lakeside town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Distraught after dropping a cherished gift from her father into the lake, she spends her time crying along the town's docks. Amid the mounting threats of gnoll invasions and Blackrock orc warbands pressing down on Lakeshire, the children of the town still face everyday childhood troubles. Hilary accidentally dropped a necklace given to her by her father into the murky waters of Lake Everstill. Terrified that her father will be angry with her, the distraught girl waits by the town pier in tears, hoping someone brave enough will plunge into the lake to retrieve it.

npc:nikova-raskol.text: Nikova Raskol. Nikova Raskol is an elderly human townsperson who walks the cobblestone streets of Old Town in Stormwind City. Grieving the murder of her grandson at the hands of the Defias Brotherhood, she seeks justice against the rioting criminals locked inside the Stockade. Nikova wanders Old Town carrying the weight of a recent and devastating personal tragedy. Her beloved grandson, Mac, was slain by brigands belonging to the Defias Brotherhood. While the kingdom grapples with treason on a political scale, Nikova represents the intimate human cost inflicted upon everyday citizens by the Brotherhood's lawless rampage. Though many of the criminals who wrecked havoc were captured and thrown into the Stockade, prison bars offer little solace now that a violent inmate rebellion has seized the facility. Frustrated by the guards' inability to restore order, Nikova appeals directly to brave adventurers heading into the prison, asking them to collect red Defias bandanas as proof that her grandson's killers have finally faced retribution.

npc:nissa-firestone.text: Nissa Firestone. Nissa Firestone is a dwarven physician stationed above the bustle of the Great Forge in Ironforge. She serves as an instructor in field medicine, teaching travelers and soldiers how to dress wounds and bind trauma. Amid the clanging metal and blistering heat of the Great Forge, Nissa Firestone practices medicine from the upper floor of the Ironforge Physician shop. While dwarven warriors are famed for their endurance, even stone-hard skin splits against blade and claw. Nissa ensures that those heading out into the snows of Dun Morogh or beyond know how to keep themselves and their allies alive with basic bandaging and field dressings. For field medics who have mastered the basics of cloth and lint, Nissa recognizes when a student has outgrown her clinic. When practitioners reach the limits of what she can teach, she points them toward specialized triage officers in far-flung outposts, directing skilled healers to where the Alliance's casualties are heaviest.

npc:nogg.text: Nogg. Nogg is a goblin engineer operating out of a workshop in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He offers tinkering expertise and specialized craftsmanship to the Horde, notably analyzing strange mechanical salvage recovered from deep within Gnomeregan. Tucked away in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Nogg runs an independent engineering workshop catering to adventurers and craftsmen alike. While the surrounding city relies heavily on traditional orcish steel and brute strength, Nogg provides the specialized mechanical finesse that only a goblin can offer. He maintains a keen interest in foreign contraptions and tech, happily examining curious trinkets and mechanical oddities dragged back from Alliance lands or subterranean ruins. Nogg takes special interest in items recovered from the fallen gnomish capital of Gnomeregan. When Horde operatives retrieve intricate rings or technological remnants from the irradiated vaults across the sea, Nogg is one of the few minds in Durotar capable of disassembling, deciphering, and retrofitting such bizarre clockwork mechanisms for Horde use.

npc:nori-pridedrift.text: Nori Pridedrift. Nori Pridedrift is an enterprising dwarf peddling his piping-hot Scalding Mornbrew throughout snowy Coldridge Valley. He makes his living braving the cold to supply shivering mountaineers with their morning pick-me-up, often enlisting swift recruits to run deliveries while the drink remains steaming. Life in Coldridge Valley is harsh and bitterly cold, and nothing cuts through the chill quite like a draught of Scalding Mornbrew. Nori Pridedrift has carved out a living by brewing and distributing this hot, coffee-like morning drink across the frozen drifts. Because the brew must be consumed while still scalding to be fully appreciated, delivery is a race against the elements. Nori frequently recruits brisk couriers to sprint fresh draughts out to freezing sentries before the mountain air robs the brew of its heat. Just as important as the brew itself are his limited supplies of sturdy mugs, which he expects his runners to return promptly.

npc:novice-elreth.text: Novice Elreth. Novice Elreth is an undead member of the Forsaken stationed inside the chapel at Deathknell. As newly risen undead awaken into their second life, she directs them to confront the mindless Scourge haunting the nearby graves and tend to the tragic aftermath of the plague. Inside the desecrated chapel at Deathknell, Novice Elreth assists the emerging undead as they struggle to understand their horrific awakening. Rather than succumbing to despair or the mindless hunger of the Scourge, the Forsaken must organize quickly to secure their territory. Elreth provides newly freed souls with early tasks, directing them to gather paws and wings from the wolves and bats to the south and deal with the lingering remnants of Lordaeron's tragic downfall, including the sorrow of her friend Marla Fipps, slain by her own husband Samuel after he joined the mindless Scourge.

npc:oben-rageclaw.text: Oben Rageclaw. Oben Rageclaw is the restless spirit of a night elf druid haunting the corrupted depths of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den in Teldrassil. While his spirit wanders trapped in the barrow den, his slumbering physical form has fallen under the sway of foul furbolg magic. Like many Druids of the Claw, Oben Rageclaw retreated into the subterranean sanctum of Ban'ethil Barrow Den to commune with nature and wander the Emerald Dream. However, when the native Gnarlpine furbolgs fell to corruption and overran the barrows, Oben was caught entirely defenseless in his trance. Rather than simply slaying him, the corrupted Gnarlpine shaman used dark rituals to seize control of his comatose mortal frame, leaving his displaced spirit lingering as an anguished ghost unable to pass on or wake.

npc:ogtinc.text: Ogtinc. Ogtinc is an independent furbolg hunter perched on a high ridge overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. Having parted ways with his tribe to serve the balance of nature, he acts as a trusted ally and mentor for the Cenarion Circle. Skilled hunters seeking to test their craft against the fiercest beasts of Kalimdor often seek out his guidance. While most furbolg in Kalimdor remain fiercely bound to their tribes—or have succumbed to corruption following the Third War—Ogtinc chose a distinct path. Departing from his kin, he dedicated his bow and survival lore to aiding the Cenarion Circle. He makes his camp high on a bluff southeast of Timbermaw Hold, vigilantly watching over the ancient, shattered lands of Azshara. Ogtinc is renowned among seasoned trackers for his intimate understanding of Kalimdor's wilderness. He tests hunters who have honed their skills across the continents, dispatching them to gather rare trophies—such as the antlers of courser beasts, the scale of wave-thrashed sea serpents, and parts from green dragonkin. Through these trials, he teaches that true hunting honors the natural world and preserves balance rather than mindlessly taking life.

npc:ogunaro-wolfrunner.text: Ogunaro Wolfrunner. Ogunaro Wolfrunner is the Horde's premier wolf breeder and kennel keeper in Orgrimmar, stationed by the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor. He tends the fierce wolves chosen to bear orc champions and their trusted allies into battle. For seasoned riders seeking a bond with Durotar's apex predators, Ogunaro is the master to see. Situated near the Hunter's Hall within the Valley of Honor, Ogunaro Wolfrunner oversees the breeding and conditioning of Orgrimmar's battle wolves. The bond between orc and wolf dates back generations across the plains of Draenor and the rugged wilderness of Durotar, representing a partnership of mutual respect rather than mere domestication. Ogunaro ensures only the hardiest, fiercest beasts—from dire wolves to agile timber prowlers—are entrusted to warriors who have proven their strength and worth to the warchief.

npc:old-murk-eye.text: Old Murk-Eye. Old Murk-Eye is an infamous, battle-hardened murloc prowling the southern coastline of Westfall. Revered among his kind and feared by coastal sailors, he serves as a lethal menace to anyone wandering near the Westfall Lighthouse. While murlocs are a common pest along the shores of Westfall, Old Murk-Eye stands apart from the lesser scavengers. Considerably tougher and far more aggressive than his kin, this grizzled beast prowls the surf surrounding the Westfall Lighthouse. His continued presence has caused enough grief to local mariners that the spectral Captain Grayson seeks his death, offering a bounty for the creature's pristine scales to break his grip on the shallows.

npc:orendil-broadleaf.text: Orendil Broadleaf. Orendil Broadleaf is a skilled night elf herbalist and healer stationed at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. Known for his deep knowledge of forest flora, he concocts vital remedies to save young lives across the troubled woodlands. Positioned at Maestra's Post along the western threshold of Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick as a skilled healer. Recognized for his masterful knowledge of local herbs and restorative craft, Orendil relies on passing travelers to gather rare natural reagents. Even as tension and conflict encroach upon the forest, his tireless focus remains on safeguarding his kin and soothing their ailments.

npc:orenthil-whisperwind.text: Orenthil Whisperwind. Orenthil Whisperwind is a night elf resident of Teldrassil, encountered beneath the boughs of Shadowglen. Orenthil Whisperwind resides among the night elves of Shadowglen, beneath the canopy of Teldrassil. Little is recorded about his personal history.

npc:ormak-grimshot.text: Ormak Grimshot. Ormak Grimshot is an experienced orc hunter trainer residing in the Hunter's Hall within Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Accompanied by his loyal wolf, Grimfang, he instructs young hunters of the Horde in tracking, marksmanship, and bonding with wild beasts. Stationed within the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor, Ormak Grimshot serves as a cornerstone of martial instruction for the Horde's trackers and marksmen. Alongside his companion wolf, Grimfang, Ormak imparts the foundational discipline needed to survive Kalimdor's harsh wilderness. For orc and troll hunters arriving from their trials in Durotar, he provides vital guidance on the sacred art of taming and commanding wild beasts, ensuring every hunter forms an enduring bond with their animal partner.

npc:ormer-ironbraid.text: Ormer Ironbraid. Ormer Ironbraid is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at Whelgar's Excavation Site in the southern Wetlands. His team's historical research has been violently interrupted by ravenous raptors that overran the dig. Ormer seeks adventurous allies to clear out the beasts and avenge the miners driven from the site. Ormer Ironbraid arrived in the Wetlands as part of the dwarven effort to uncover Titan relics and ancient history at Whelgar's Excavation Site. Unfortunately, uncovering ancient stones also unearthed—or at least provoked—packs of fierce Wetlands raptors. Rather than cataloging ancient earthenware and tablets, Ormer spends his days watching the beasts prowl among the ruins, nursing a fierce hatred for the creatures that disrupted their work. Ormer refuses to abandon the dig, but he lacks the raw muscle to purge the site alone. He directs his frustration into a systematic campaign of extermination, enlisting passing travelers to slay raptors of increasing size and ferocity. For Ormer, reclaiming the excavation is not just about the artifacts—it is a deeply personal matter of dwarven pride and vengeance against the local wildlife.

npc:orokk-omosh.text: Orokk Omosh. Orokk Omosh is an aging orc blacksmith stationed in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. As the last heir to a storied lineage of smiths, he seeks worthy apprentices across the Horde to preserve his family's armoring secrets before they are lost to time. Standing beside the roaring forges in the Valley of Honor, Orokk Omosh carries a heavy burden: he is the final smith of the venerable Omosh line. Having fathered no children to inherit his craft, Orokk refuses to let his family's hard-won techniques die with him. Instead, he invites capable Horde blacksmiths to undertake demanding trials of metalwork, promising to impart the revered secrets of Omosh armorcraft to those who prove their dedication. Despite the somber reality of his fading bloodline, Orokk is known among fellow artisans for his boisterous enthusiasm when true mastery is displayed. Completing his trials of craftsmanship earns more than just specialized armoring patterns—it often provokes the famous 'Omosh Dance of Joy,' a jubilant celebration of traditional smithing that echoes through the halls of Orgrimmar.

npc:orphan-matron-battlewail.text: Orphan Matron Battlewail. Orphan Matron Battlewail manages the Horde orphanage in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Together with her fellow caretaker Tosamina, she shelters and raises young orc children who have lost their families to continuous warfare. War takes a constant toll across Azeroth, and the young capital of Orgrimmar bears witness to those costs. Orphan Matron Battlewail tends to the youngsters who lost their kin to violence, ensuring that the next generation of the Horde is protected, sheltered, and nurtured. Working alongside Tosamina in the Valley of Honor, Battlewail opens the orphanage doors to passing adventurers, especially during festive traditions like Children's Week when travelers are called upon to mentor these youths.

npc:orphan-matron-nightingale.text: Orphan Matron Nightingale. Orphan Matron Nightingale oversees the Stormwind Orphanage located in Cathedral Square. Alongside Matron Shellene, she cares for children who have lost their families to the relentless conflicts troubling the kingdom. She also enlists trusted Alliance adventurers to mentor and inspire her young wards during Children's Week. Standing watch just outside the orphanage south-east of the Cathedral of Light, Orphan Matron Nightingale tends to Stormwind's most vulnerable survivors. Recent wars, gnoll rampages, and the rise of the Defias Brotherhood have left many children without homes or parents. Nightingale and her fellow caretaker, Matron Shellene, provide these youngsters shelter, basic care, and guidance beneath the watchful eye of the Church of the Holy Light. Believing that hope is as vital as food and shelter, Matron Nightingale organizes Stormwind's Children's Week celebrations. During this time, she appeals directly to Alliance heroes to chaperone an orphan on travels across Azeroth. By pairing these children with celebrated champions, she hopes to instill confidence, grant them a broader view of the world outside the city walls, and remind them that they are never truly forgotten.

npc:osric-strang.text: Osric Strang. Osric Strang is a veteran armor merchant who operates Limited Immunity, a shop situated in Stormwind's Old Town. Specializing in heavy mail and plate, he supplies sturdy gear and shields to Alliance defenders and weary travelers passing through the capital. Tucked away in the weathered streets of Old Town, Osric Strang manages Limited Immunity, a shop catering to frontline fighters in need of heavy armor and shields. While his wares are suited for standard soldiers and traveling adventurers, he often assists incoming couriers who need a point of contact when arriving in the capital from nearby settlements like Westfall's Sentinel Hill.

npc:overlord-mok-morokk.text: Overlord Mok'Morokk. Overlord Mok'Morokk is the brute chieftain of the Stonemaul ogres, presiding over Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. Originally appointed by Rexxar for his strength, he has become a tyrannical and cowardly ruler who refuses to defend his clan against the black dragonflight. When Rexxar bested the previous chieftain Kor'gall and led the Stonemaul clan in defense of Durotar, he left Mok'Morokk in command, seeing promise in his sheer martial strength. That faith proved misplaced. Mok'Morokk quickly succumbed to the corrupting influence of absolute authority, ruling through intimidation and self-indulgence rather than stewardship. Instead of caring for his kin, he demands unearned tribute, lounges in Brackenwall Village, and bullies anyone who questions his command.

npc:pao-ka-swiftmountain.text: Pao'ka Swiftmountain. Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a young tauren naturalist stranded among the wild wyverns of Highperch in Thousand Needles. Having traveled south under the guidance of Motega Firemane, his youthful curiosity got the better of him when he ventured too close to a nesting site and ended up cornered in the cliffs. Pao'ka came to the canyon country of Thousand Needles alongside Motega Firemane, eager to catalog and study the dangerous beasts of the canyons. His father had been reluctant to let his son go on such a perilous journey, and Pao'ka's recent misadventure proves those concerns were warranted. Fascinated by the magnificent wyverns inhabiting Highperch, the young scholar crept up the mountain trail behind a solitary tauren totem. Unsurprisingly, the territorial beasts took offense to his intrusion, driving him deep into the crags where he found himself trapped and terrified, unable to slip past the swooping predators to return to Whitereach Post.

npc:parqual-fintallas.text: Parqual Fintallas. Parqual Fintallas is a Forsaken scholar and former human historian of Lordaeron, currently residing in the Undercity's Apothecarium. Despite the grim surroundings of his undead existence, he retains a polite demeanor and an enduring passion for ancient lore, often assisting travelers sent to consult his deep historical expertise. In life, Parqual was a respected human scholar of Lordaeron who knew all there was to know of the kingdom, immersing himself in historical texts. When the plague of undeath struck, Parqual was among the many citizens slain and raised, only to eventually break free under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. While the Forsaken largely embrace cold pragmatism and turn away from their former lives, Parqual retains his scholarly passion and pleasant manners, still seeking enlightenment, though of a different nature than in life. Parqual dwells among the bubbling vats and alchemists of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Despite his macabre surroundings, he remains an invaluable font of knowledge regarding Azeroth's history. When adventurers undertake rigorous intellectual trials—such as the elusive 'Test of Lore'—they are directed to Parqual, who sends them to the Scarlet Monastery's library for a book and then puts a question of his own to them.

npc:pilot-bellowfiz.text: Pilot Bellowfiz. Pilot Bellowfiz, affectionately known as 'Fizzer,' is a dwarven driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. As a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, he is responsible for maintaining and fielding heavy dwarven war machines, specifically his own siege engine, Jetsteam. Stationed just outside the bustling halls of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz represents the mechanical backbone of the dwarven military. Piloting the powerful siege engine known as Jetsteam, Bellowfiz spends his days tuning components, procuring essential parts, and keeping his machine battle-ready. Alongside his comrade Pilot Stonegear, Bellowfiz is constantly discussing vehicular designs, armor plating, and engine output, ensuring that the mountain kingdom's mechanized firepower remains unmatched across Khaz Modan.

npc:pilot-hammerfoot.text: Pilot Hammerfoot. Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed near the mountain passes connecting Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Worried for a fellow pilot lost in the hills, he seeks willing adventurers to search for his friend. His presence highlights the dangers faced by dwarves along the high alpine ridges. Ironforge's siege engines are the pride of its Siege Brigade, but driving them across harsh mountainous terrain carries extreme risk. Stationed at the North Gate Outpost overlooking the border between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, Pilot Hammerfoot guards the pilots' engines and watches the mountain passes. When a pilot goes missing, finding him quickly becomes a priority, especially with savage beasts prowling the nearby hills.

npc:pilot-longbeard.text: Pilot Longbeard. Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed in the Hall of Arms within Ironforge's Military Ward. Though posted in the mountain city, he maintains close ties with gnomish tinkerers and fellow racing enthusiasts operating far away in the Shimmering Flats. Found amongst the martial displays and weaponsmiths of Ironforge's Military Ward, Pilot Longbeard represents the proud siege engine corps of Khaz Modan. While his duties keep him within the fortress city, Longbeard keeps an eager ear out for innovations and news from fellow mechanics across the continent, including the Brassbolts brothers tinkering out on the salt flats of Kalimdor. Longbeard serves as a point of contact for adventurous travelers heading south into Kalimdor. He frequently directs promising recruits and couriers toward the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles, where gnomish inventors push mechanical boundaries alongside their goblin rivals.

npc:pilot-stonegear.text: Pilot Stonegear. Pilot Stonegear, nicknamed 'Stone', is a dwarf mechanic and driver in the Ironforge Siege Brigade stationed at Steelgrill's Depot. He operates the formidable siege engine known as Trollplow and works tirelessly to enhance its performance and armor. Adventurers traveling through Dun Morogh often help him secure rare materials to keep his war machine battle-ready. Stationed among the rumbling boilers and clanking tracks of Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear serves Ironforge as a proud driver in the Siege Brigade. His pride and joy is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to smash through enemy lines. Stonegear takes his machine seriously—knowing that in the heat of battle, a driver's life depends entirely on the resilience of gears, plates, and steam pressure. He constantly seeks to fine-tune both Trollplow's combat efficiency and the everyday livability of its cramped cockpit. Like many dwarven and gnomish grease-monkeys at the depot, Stonegear is rarely content with factory specifications. He often spends off-duty hours debating engineering schematics with comrades like Pilot Bellowfiz. Whether chasing down rumors of exotic ores or tracking down volatile minerals to fuel enhanced plating and munitions, Stonegear relies on eager recruits to venture into the snowy wilderness and dangerous caves of Dun Morogh on supply runs.

npc:pixel.text: Pixel. Pixel is an enterprising goblin courier operating out of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Making her living delivering heavy goods across dangerous territories, she handles shipments like Warsong saw blades for the local Horde forces—though she never lets any cargo go without proper compensation. While Splintertree Post serves as a fortified bastion for the Horde amidst the hostile canopies of Ashenvale, Pixel remains firmly focused on profit. As an independent courier willing to haul freight into active war zones, she provides essential logistics for the Warsong Clan's logging efforts. However, true to goblin custom, contracts and coin dictate her cooperation. She holds fast to her deliveries until the client produces payment; for the saw blades, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to protect herself on the road. Always alert to an opportunity, she also pays passing adventurers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.

npc:piznik.text: Piznik. Piznik is a disgruntled goblin surveyor hiding deep within Windshear Mine in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a high-ranking overseer in the local Venture Company operations, he was sidelined by the ruthless Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Now nursing a grudge, Piznik secretly gathers intel to undermine his former workplace. Before Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle seized supreme authority over Windshear Crag, Piznik held the enviable title of second-in-command across the entire operation. However, corporate restructuring in the Venture Company is unforgiving. Once Gerenzo took full control, Piznik found himself pushed aside and relegated to the murky depths of Windshear Mine. Rather than accepting his demotion quietly, Piznik bides his time underground, keeping a watchful eye on mine movements and quietly plotting revenge against the boss who demoted him.

npc:pozzik.text: Pozzik. Pozzik is an esteemed goblin tinkerer and racer stationed at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Once one of the most respected engineers in Undermine, he now dedicates his technical genius to constructing experimental rocket cars and settling the ultimate debate of engineering supremacy against his gnome counterpart. Before retiring to the harsh salt flats of Thousand Needles, Pozzik built a legendary reputation among the goblins. As one of the most respected tinkerers out of Undermine, his technical expertise spans complex internal combustion, propulsion, and hazardous chassis construction. Rather than settling into comfortable obscurity, however, Pozzik took his mechanical mastery into the desert to push high-speed machinery far past its breaking point. At the Mirage Raceway, Pozzik teamed up with his perennial gnome counterpart, Fizzle Brassbolts. Despite the historic rivalry between goblin explosives and delicate gnomish calibration, the two worked together to construct the sprawling racetrack across the dried lakebed. They field opposing racing outfits, testing prototype rocket cars to definitively prove whose racial design philosophy dominates the track. Naturally, Pozzik is always on the lookout for resourceful adventurers willing to acquire parts and shave weight off his designs.

npc:priestess-a-moora.text: Priestess A'moora. Priestess A'moora is a devout night elf servant of the Moon Goddess residing within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Working closely under the guidance of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's priesthood, she attends to rituals of spiritual purification and communion with Elune. Travelers exploring Teldrassil are often directed to her when matters involve sacred offerings and the mystical wildlife of the boughs. Within the serene marble halls of the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora spends her days in contemplation and service. As an ordained priestess of Elune, she assists in tending the spiritual needs of Darnassus and preserving the delicate rituals passed down through millennia. While much of the Sisterhood oversees military defenses or diplomacy, A'moora focuses on traditional devotions and sacred matters concerning the natural spirits of Teldrassil. A'moora is tied to the sad fate of Lady Sathrah, a great spider once beloved of Elune whose silvery dew was kept in the temple for its healing powers. When Sathrah descended into madness, A'moora sent young adventurers to the northern borders of Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake to end her suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets. Offered at the temple's fountain, the spinnerets become a sacrifice to Elune so that Sathrah might be reborn at peace.

npc:priestess-anetta.text: Priestess Anetta. Priestess Anetta is a human cleric of the Holy Light stationed inside Northshire Abbey. As a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire, she instructs newly arrived priests in their first sacred rites. Priestess Anetta can be found on the ground floor of Northshire Abbey within its quiet library wing. Amid the threat of Defias bandits and kobolds troubling the valley, she serves as a grounding presence for the Brotherhood of Northshire, reminding all who pass not to turn their backs on the Light, for it may be the one thing that saves them someday. Within the cloister, Anetta acts as the primary mentor for budding human priests. Novices who arrive with a hallowed letter of introduction seek her out to learn the fundamentals of faith: channeling holy words to mend flesh and unleashing smiting radiance to repel evil. Under her tutelage, young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire's secluded walls.

npc:priestess-josetta.text: Priestess Josetta. Priestess Josetta is a human priest trainer stationed on the upper floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Dedicated to guiding novices of the Holy Light beyond their initial trials in Northshire, she mentors young priests in faith, devotion, and practical ministry. While many who take holy vows spend their days within grand cathedrals or cloistered monasteries, Priestess Josetta ministers directly among the common folk of Elwynn Forest. From her modest quarters upstairs in the bustling Lion's Pride Inn, she attends to the spiritual health of travelers, guards, and local laborers alike, demonstrating that service to the Holy Light requires presence wherever hearts need solace. Josetta plays a vital role for budding priests who have completed their initial studies at Northshire Abbey. She instructs them in the practical realities of their calling, sending them into the surrounding countryside to aid wounded guards and comfort the afflicted. Through these tasks, she emphasizes that clerical duties are not merely about learning words of prayer, but actively channeling the Light to mend a broken world. Despite her steady devotion, Josetta carries a touch of wistfulness regarding her life's choices. In her youth, she lacked the courage to step onto the wider roads and explore Azeroth, choosing instead the safety of familiar ground. Though content in her sacred service in Goldshire, she often urges the young disciples who cross her threshold to be bolder than she was and take their faith to distant frontiers.

npc:prospector-ironband.text: Prospector Ironband. Prospector Darteus Ironband is an honest, hardworking dwarven surveyor who oversees an archaeological dig in southeastern Loch Modan. Working under the banner of the Dwarven Explorers' Guild, he is determined to uncover the earthen heritage buried beneath Khaz Modan. Despite setbacks and hostile local creatures, Ironband remains committed to sending regular progress reports and uncovered relics back to Ironforge. Darteus Ironband leads the dig at Ironband's Excavation Site nestled in the hills of southeastern Loch Modan. Like many field researchers in the Explorers' Guild, Ironband believes that the soil of Khaz Modan hides vital truths about the origins of the dwarven race. His camp works tirelessly digging trenches and sifting through rubble in search of ancient relics, stone tablets, and earthen artifacts. Despite the slow pace of unearthing buried history, Ironband's resolve remains unshaken, and he is always eager to recruit competent adventurers to safeguard his operation. Conducting an excavation in the rugged wilds is never quiet. The site faces relentless harassment from local troggs and wildlife, threatening the supply lines and equipment essential for the dig. Relics and valuable survey equipment are constantly at risk of being stolen or wrecked before they can be examined. Ironband relies on visiting Alliance travelers to protect the cargo shipments, keep hostile raiders at bay, and investigate missing guild contacts in the neighboring badlands.

npc:prospector-remtravel.text: Prospector Remtravel. Prospector Remtravel is a dwarven archaeologist affiliated with the Explorers' League, stationed deep in the gloomy woodlands of Darkshore. He oversees an excavation site unearthing ancient relics, though his scattered focus and perilous surroundings leave him in constant need of assistance. Sent far across the sea by the Explorers' League, Prospector Remtravel established his dig site along the southern reaches of Darkshore. While the night elves are often protective of their ancestral territories, the League's insatiable drive to uncover the origins of Azeroth pushes prospectors into every forgotten corner. Remtravel's work unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, but the aggressive native wildlife and hostile local threats make managing a frontier dig almost more than one scatterbrained dwarf can handle.

npc:prospector-ryedol.text: Prospector Ryedol. Prospector Ryedol is an Explorers' League surveyor stationed on a dusty rise overlooking the eastern Badlands. Watching over the perilous excavations below, he strives to recover lost dwarven relics and maintain hope in a barren wasteland overrun by troggs and beasts. Perched upon a rugged hill just south of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol represents the ongoing efforts of Ironforge's Explorers' League in the Badlands. The arid valley is rich in ancient titan secrets and earthen heritage, but field expeditions here are constantly beleaguered by savage troggs, ravenous coyotes, and territorial drakes. Ryedol coordinates retrieval efforts for dwarven gear stolen by the Dark Iron dwarves and seeks signs of hope amid the ruined outposts, determined not to let the League's sacrifices in the wastes be in vain.

npc:prospector-stormpike.text: Prospector Stormpike. Prospector Stormpike is a blunt, short-tempered dwarf stationed within the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. A member of the renowned Stormpike clan, he oversees logistical support for distant archaeological digs and lends his sharp intellect to deciphering coded missives. Tucked away amid the towering bookshelves of the Hall of Explorers, Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavation efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Despite his gruff demeanor and impatience with idle chatter, he is deeply dedicated to uncovering dwarven history, keeping distant sites supplied with essentials like blasting powder. Beneath his rough exterior lies a keen analytical mind skilled at breaking intricate ciphers, making him an unexpected asset to Alliance scouts dealing with clandestine threats.

npc:prospector-whelgar.text: Prospector Whelgar. Prospector Whelgar is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at an excavation site in the Wetlands east of Menethil Harbor. His mission to uncover titan relics has stalled after vicious raptors overran the dig. He now seeks hardy adventurers willing to brave the beasts to recover ancient artifacts. Sent into the marshy wilderness of the Wetlands to unearth the history of the dwarven race, Prospector Whelgar established an archaeological camp known as Whelgar's Excavation Site. The valley was once rich with ancient stone relics, but the local raptors quickly grew territorial and drove his team into hiding. Despite the danger, Whelgar refuses to abandon his duty. He remains focused on recovering valuable relics—including the enigmatic Goaz Stone—before wild predators or rival scoundrels ruin the site entirely.

npc:quartermaster-lewis.text: Quartermaster Lewis. Quartermaster Lewis is a human supply merchant stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, he provides rations, ammunition, and everyday provisions to travelers and defenders attempting to hold the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood. Perched inside Sentinel Tower, Quartermaster Lewis manages the meager logistical lifeline of the Westfall militia. With Stormwind's royal leadership offering little aid to the impoverished region, Sentinel Hill relies on local volunteers and whatever supplies they can gather. Lewis distributes standard field necessities, from dry rations and fresh water to arrows, shot, and throwing blades, ensuring the fighters standing watch have the bare essentials to survive Defias raids.

npc:quinn-yorick.text: Quinn Yorick. Quinn Yorick is a wounded Forsaken scout sheltering on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch. Having barely survived an encounter with the ghoul known as Ivar the Foul, he now relies on passing allies to help secure his survival. Tucked away inside an abandoned home at the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs. His condition is the result of a vicious clash with Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm's barn in the northern stretches of Silverpine Forest. Sent with his sister Rane to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec, Quinn cannot finish his mission or safely retreat alone, so he remains in hiding while travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.

npc:ragnar-thunderbrew.text: Ragnar Thunderbrew. Ragnar Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer and co-owner of the renowned Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Known across Dun Morogh for serving his family's signature Beer Basted Boar Ribs, he works constantly to keep the busy tavern stocked and its patrons satisfied. Standing inside the Thunderbrew Distillery at Kharanos, Ragnar Thunderbrew manages the establishment's culinary reputation alongside his family's brewing operations. The distillery is a central gathering place for local mountaineers, traveling adventurers, and gnome refugees fleeing Gnomeregan. Chief among his duties is preparing the family's renowned Beer Basted Boar Ribs, a hearty Dun Morogh specialty cooked with stout dwarven ale. However, maintaining steady supplies has become difficult; his usual meat provider enlisted in the King's Army, leaving Ragnar dependent on wandering mountaineers and hunters to keep fresh crag boar flanks coming into the kitchen. The Thunderbrew name is synonymous with dwarven alcohol and pub culture throughout Ironforge territory. Ragnar has kept the family distillery running since his older brother, Grimbooze Thunderbrew, disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago, defending the family's fiercely guarded brewing heritage against thieves like the Dark Iron dwarves, who stole the recipe for Thunderbrew Lager. Between restless patrons, missing supply lines, and rowdy tavern disputes, Ragnar keeps a steady hand on the taps, ensuring no traveler departs Kharanos with an empty mug or an empty belly.

npc:rahauro.text: Rahauro. Rahauro is a tauren attendant found on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, faithfully serving the elder crone Magatha Grimtotem. Acting on her behalf, he recruits brave adventurers to venture into the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. He coordinates efforts to retaliate against the hostile troggs and recover missing possessions belonging to his mistress's fallen agents. Standing loyally near Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise, Rahauro acts as her direct intermediary. Magatha often operates through trusted underlings rather than soiling her own hooves with public recruitment. When reports emerge of wild creatures swarming beneath the orcish capital, it is Rahauro who handles the logistical details, dispatching Horde mercenaries to deal with the uprising. The troggs infesting the subterranean caverns of Ragefire Chasm did not respond kindly to diplomatic outreach. Magatha originally dispatched envoys in an attempt to forge peace with the primitive beasts, but the troggs turned violently on the delegates and butchered them. Viewing them as an intolerable threat to the Horde, Rahauro directs champions into the caverns to cull the troggs and assess their true strength.

npc:raleigh-andrean.text: Raleigh Andrean. Raleigh Andrean is a Forsaken resident of the Undercity. His requests reveal a callous attitude toward his former human life and those he once knew. Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Raleigh Andrean lived an ordinary human life, married to a woman named Deliah and keeping company with his friend Valdred Moray. Like countless others, he fell when the Scourge tore through the kingdom, only to be raised as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. He regained his free will following the shattering of the Ner'zhul's grip and Sylvanas Windrunner's uprising, taking his place among the Forsaken in the Undercity.

npc:randis.text: Randis. Randis is a spirited young human orphan under the care of Orphan Matron Nightingale at the orphanage in Cathedral Square. During Children's Week, he eagerly accompanies willing adventurers across the Alliance's territories to take in sights far beyond the city walls. Residing in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Randis is one of many children left without family in the wake of the realm's persistent conflicts. When the annual Children's Week arrives, Orphan Matron Nightingale entrusts sympathetic heroes with a whistle to take him under their wing. Full of youthful curiosity and nonstop questions, Randis dreams of adventuring, asks endless riddles, and boldly declares that when he grows up, he wants to be the king of Stormwind. For a boy who spends most of his days penned up in Cathedral Square, leaving the capital is a grand adventure. Though he is quick to note that places like Ironforge smell rather odd, his boundless wonder reflects the innocent future that heroes of the Alliance fight to protect.

npc:rau-cliffrunner.text: Rau Cliffrunner. Rau Cliffrunner is a tauren scout and scholar stationed high atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Dedicated to protecting his people from regional threats, he studies the history and origins of the hostile Galak centaur through their ancient relics. Working closely with allies in Thunder Bluff, Rau coordinates ventures into dangerous enemy strongholds across the canyon. Perched on the perilous bluffs of Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner maintains a watchful eye over the sweeping, sun-scorched expanse of Thousand Needles. The tauren outpost serves as a crucial Horde sanctuary in an otherwise hostile territory teeming with ferocious predators, quilboar, and aggressive centaur clans. Rau acts as both an outpost organizer and a dedicated investigator, keen on neutralizing emerging threats before they can overwhelm the vulnerable mesa settlements.

npc:razzle-sprysprocket.text: Razzle Sprysprocket. Razzle Sprysprocket is a gnomish engineer residing in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Known for his technical tinkering alongside Ozzie Togglevolt, he enlists travelers to help salvage disrupted gnomish machinery and components around the snowy hills. Following the tragedy at Gnomeregan, Razzle Sprysprocket found refuge among the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh, setting up his workshop in Kharanos. With a knack for delicate mechanical parts, Razzle works alongside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Their efforts frequently involve recovering gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies that were lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland. Life in Dun Morogh is far from peaceful for a gnome inventor. Between the wild beasts of the frozen ridges and raids by local Frostmane trolls, Razzle's work is never entirely safe. Despite the dangers, he remains dedicated to keeping gnomish contraptions functional and recovering the lost wonders of Gnomeregan.

npc:red-jack-flint.text: Red Jack Flint. Red Jack Flint is a seasoned human mariner stationed within Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. A member of the crew of the vessel Maiden's Virtue, he serves as a point of contact for travelers seeking passage or contacts across the sea toward Kalimdor. Found inside the stone walls of Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint is an experienced seafarer tied to the harbor's maritime trade. As part of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue, he navigates the dangerous sea routes linking the marshlands of Khaz Modan with distant shores. Rather than staying confined to naval routine, Flint directs capable adventurers to allies across the Great Sea, including contacts in Kalimdor like Fiora Longears.

npc:rema-schneider.text: Rema Schneider. Rema Schneider is a human citizen who works out of the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind City. Situated along the quiet waterways between the major districts, she frequently assists local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries. Tucked away in the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, positioned just west of the stone bridge leading across to Cathedral Square, Rema Schneider manages the daily needs of urban trade. Like many skilled artisans and assistants across the city, her work keeps cloth and finished garments moving between local craftsmen, relying on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.

npc:remulos.text: Remulos. Keeper Remulos is a demigod son of Cenarius and the venerable protector of Moonglade. Alongside Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and Hamuul Runetotem, he helps guide the Cenarion Circle in the absence of his fallen father and the sleeping Malfurion Stormrage. Unlike Staghelm, Remulos prioritizes the broader balance of nature over night elven isolationism. Keeper Remulos is an immortal keeper of the grove, bearing the lower body of a great stag and the antlered torso of an ancient dryad-father. He watches over Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Azeroth's druids nestled north of Mount Hyjal. While Malfurion Stormrage remains trapped in the Emerald Dream, Remulos provides divine authority and counsel to the mortals of the Cenarion Circle. He remains deeply invested in healing Azeroth's scars, offering aid to druids pursuing their sacred rites around Lake Elune'ara. Remulos frequently finds himself at ideological odds with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm. While Staghelm champions night elven supremacy and sought to restore their lost immortality through Teldrassil, Remulos vehemently opposed the planting of the new World Tree as an act of hubris. Defying Staghelm's isolationist faction, Remulos welcomed Hamuul Runetotem and the tauren into the Cenarion Circle, sharing nature's closely guarded mysteries with their shamans-turned-druids to restore the land collectively.

npc:remy-two-times.text: Remy "Two Times". Remy "Two Times" is a human merchant currently residing in the village of Goldshire. Originally hailing from the Redridge Mountains, he is easily recognized by his peculiar habit of repeating the ends of his sentences. He maintains business interests across Elwynn Forest, trading goods and paying adventurers for raw materials like gold dust. Operating out of Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" is an enterprising trader who made his way west from the rugged terrain of the Redridge Mountains. True to his moniker, Remy possesses a distinctive verbal tick: repeating the final words of his sentences, usually twice. Despite his comical speech pattern, he remains a savvy merchant looking to turn a profit amid the growing troubles in Elwynn Forest, readily striking deals with traveling adventurers. With kobolds overrunning the local gold mines and aggressive murlocs infesting the riverbanks, normal commerce in Elwynn has been heavily disrupted. Remy seizes opportunity where others see disaster, commissioning adventurers to bring him pouchfuls of gold dust gathered from the vermin infesting the mines, as well as keeping tabs on suspicious murloc movements near Crystal Lake.

npc:renato-gallina.text: Renato Gallina. Renato Gallina is an energetic barker found promoting business in Stormwind City's bustling Trade District. A member of the Gallina winemaking family, his job is to drum up patrons and direct thirsty travelers to the family winery nestled along the city canals. Standing amidst the busy stalls of the Trade District, Renato Gallina spends his days calling out to passers-by, boldly proclaiming that his family sells the finest vintages in all of Stormwind. His family operates the Gallina Winery located nearby along the Canals, and Renato serves as their public promoter, handing out pamphlets that passers-by can bring to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.

npc:renzik-the-shiv.text: Renzik "The Shiv". Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and the trusted second-in-command of SI:7, stationed inside their headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town. He serves Spymaster Mathias Shaw faithfully, directing the new rogue recruits sent to him from across the Alliance. Renzik keeps the story of his past to himself. What Stormwind knows is that this goblin found his way into SI:7 and now stands as Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second in command. He is short on patience and pleasantries, greeting new recruits by asking whether they are ready to get to work or need a nap first. Now based inside the secretive SI:7 fortress in Old Town, Renzik serves as Mathias Shaw's second-in-command. Rogue mentors across the Alliance, from Ironforge to Darnassus, send their most promising agents to Renzik. Rather than sending them straight to slaughter, Renzik forwards them to field instructors like Lucius in Redridge to hone their survival craft.

npc:rezlak.text: Rezlak. Rezlak is a goblin entrepreneur and member of the Tinkers' Union stationed along the dusty roads of Durotar south of Orgrimmar. He hires traveling adventurers to salvage his missing supplies and clear out the harpies preying on his supply caravans. Perched beside the canyon roads connecting Razor Hill to Orgrimmar, Rezlak represents the Tinkers' Union—a goblin syndicate focused on engineering, supply lines, and industrial pragmatism. Rezlak cares little for the factional tensions of Kalimdor so long as business runs smoothly. When the fierce Dustwind harpies raided his cargo caravans and made the supply routes unsafe, Rezlak stayed put, preferring to contract out the dangerous work of extermination and recovery to any passerby willing to turn a profit.

npc:rhinag.text: Rhinag. Rhinag is an afflicted jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe, sheltering among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened by the harsh venom of the region's scorpids, he relies entirely on passing travelers to secure him a timely remedy. While traversing the arid terrain of Durotar, Rhinag fell victim to the vicious sting of a local Venomtail Scorpid. Overwhelmed by the potent poison, he took shelter among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened and isolated, his survival hinges on anyone who happens by with the resolve to procure a venomtail antidote before the toxins take their final toll.

npc:ringo.text: Ringo. Ringo is an unfortunate goblin explorer who ventured up the blistering heights of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Overwhelmed by the volcano's stifling heat and noxious vapors, he collapsed inside a cave, desperate for someone to help him back down. His close friend Spraggle Frock remains worried sick back at Marshal's Refuge. While goblins are known for braving hazardous environments in search of wealth or oddities, Fire Plume Ridge proves harsh even by their standards. Towering in the center of Un'Goro Crater, the active volcano spews ash, magma, and boiling steam. Ringo climbed about halfway up the southern face before the suffocating heat finally proved too much for him. Leaving his belongings scattered just outside, he crawled into a cave to shelter from the sweltering atmosphere, completely incapacitated by heat exhaustion.

npc:rivern-frostwind.text: Rivern Frostwind. Rivern Frostwind is a night elf riding instructor stationed high atop Frostsaber Rock in northern Winterspring. Accompanied by his frost tiger companion Glacier, he watches over the native wintersabers and trains riders deemed worthy by his order. Only the most dedicated champions of the Alliance are granted the honor of riding one of his prized mounts. Perched on the icy promontory of Frostsaber Rock, Rivern Frostwind oversees the breeding and stewardship of the legendary Winterspring frostsaber. While nightsabers roam the lush forests of Teldrassil and Ashenvale, their sub-arctic cousins are bred to endure the bitter cold of northern Kalimdor. Rivern acts as a gatekeeper for these majestic predators. He demands that outsiders prove their commitment to preserving the beasts—gathering fresh meat from the tundra, clearing out Winterfall furbolgs, and driving back rampaging frost giants—before he will even consider entrusting one of the sabers to them.

npc:roetten-stonehammer.text: Roetten Stonehammer. Roetten Stonehammer is an enterprising dwarf found wandering the Library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Representing the interests of Reclaimers Inc., he organizes expeditions and recruits adventurers to handle salvage operations in distant lands like Desolace. Amid the ancient tomes and dust of the Hall of Explorers' Library, Roetten Stonehammer keeps his eye on matters of practical recovery. Operating on behalf of Reclaimers Inc., Roetten connects daring mercenaries with lucrative salvage contracts across Kalimdor. Rather than digging purely for historical curiosity, his associates look to reclaim valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents from perilous frontiers like the rugged wastes of Desolace.

npc:royal-historian-archesonus.text: Royal Historian Archesonus. Royal Historian Archesonus is a dwarven scholar serving King Magni Bronzebeard within Ironforge's High Seat. Renowned for her scholarly works documenting recent catastrophes in the northern human kingdoms, she also directs research into ancient dwarven tragedies, notably the scorched remains of the Dark Iron kingdom. Stationed steps from King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus maintains historical records on behalf of the Ironforge crown. Her academic gaze extends well beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She authored 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' as well as 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' tracking the horrific collapse of humanity's northern realm under the Scourge. Rather than hiding from dark histories, Archesonus approaches disasters methodically, seeking to record the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse. In addition to her texts on Lordaeron, Archesonus oversees inquiries into the War of the Three Hammers and the catastrophic destruction of the city of Thaurissan. Seeking recovered relics and charred tablets from the Burning Steppes, she enlists adventurers to search the Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan. For Archesonus, understanding the cataclysm that scorched the Burning Steppes and bound the Dark Iron clan to the Firelord is vital statecraft—ensuring the Bronzebeard kingdom remembers exactly what sorcery and desperation can unleash.

npc:ruga-ragetotem.text: Ruga Ragetotem. Ruga Ragetotem is a veteran tauren warrior stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Serving as a mentor to promising Horde fighters, he tests their mettle against the strange silithid infestation emerging nearby before sending them toward custom armor. Standing watch over Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem helps train emerging warriors looking to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Recognizing the sudden, unsettling emergence of insectoid silithid carving hives into the Field of Giants to the south, Ruga sets a trial for young fighters to hunt the beasts and sever their antennae. Those who endure the ordeal earn his respect and a recommendation to the renowned armorsmith Thun'grim Firegaze.

npc:rutgar-glyphshaper.text: Rutgar Glyphshaper. Rutgar Glyphshaper is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at the Bronzebeard Encampment in the southern reaches of Silithus. As a member of Brann Bronzebeard's expedition, he studies ancient silithid relics and runes, striving to uncover the mystery of the hives even after Brann wanders off into the desert. Rutgar Glyphshaper traveled to Silithus under the leadership of Brann Bronzebeard to investigate the vast silithid hives and unearth lost relics buried beneath the desert wastes. Establishing their base at the Bronzebeard Encampment south of Cenarion Hold, Rutgar and his companions frequently ventured directly into the bug hives to harvest inscribed stones and runic artifacts, often cooperating with Cenarion night elf researchers.

npc:ruul-eagletalon.text: Ruul Eagletalon. Ruul Eagletalon is a tauren resident of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Stationed near the settlement's perimeter, he keeps a watchful eye on the local wildlife, particularly the aggressive Windfury harpies encroaching upon tauren lands. Ruul Eagletalon stands guard in Bloodhoof Village, tending to the security of the settlement as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. While Mulgore is a peaceful homeland compared to the arid wastes of the Barrens, territorial predators and hostile creatures continually press against the pastures. Ruul concerns himself with threats roaming the nearby plains, notably directing capable travelers to confront the savage Windfury harpies who prey on unwary nomads and game.

npc:ruul-snowhoof.text: Ruul Snowhoof. Ruul Snowhoof is a tauren druid held captive inside Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale. Trapped in his bear form within a crude cage, he relies on Horde adventurers to break him out and guide him to safety. Ruul Snowhoof ventured into northern Ashenvale only to fall into the clutches of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. When captured, he assumed the shape of a mighty bear—a guise his captors entirely mistook for an actual wild beast. Instead of slaying him outright, the furbolgs locked him inside a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold, leaving him to slowly starve. Weakened and unable to safely drop his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for allies of the Horde to spring his lock, fight off his jailers, and clear a path through the den so he can return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.

npc:rwag.text: Rwag. Rwag is the orc rogue trainer stationed in the Den, tucked within Durotar's Valley of Trials. He instructs newly arrived orcs and trolls in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting under the watchful gaze of the Horde. Operating deep within the cave known as the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they step out into the wider world of Durotar. While the new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, Rwag understands that subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain invaluable tools for survival in an unforgiving desert. He keeps a sharp eye on Valley business and harbors deep suspicions regarding the dark practitioners also sheltering in the cave, particularly the warlock Nartok.

npc:saelienne.text: Saelienne. Innkeeper Saelienne manages the inn situated on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She provides weary travelers and local artisans with food, drink, and a peaceful hearthstone retreat in the heart of the night elven capital. Situated amidst the bustling workshops and trade stalls of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Innkeeper Saelienne offers a calm respite for both residents and visitors to Darnassus. As a keeper of the hearth, she caters to adventurers arriving from across Kalimdor and beyond, serving staple night elven refreshments alongside goods brought into the city port. Her establishment serves as a primary gathering place for tradesfolk seeking rest after long hours at the forge or loom.

npc:sally-whitemane.text: High Inquisitor Whitemane. Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron. Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she has become one of the Crusade's foremost symbols through her absolute conviction, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.

npc:salma-saldean.text: Salma Saldean. Salma Saldean is a hardy Westfall homesteader who tends Saldean's Farm alongside her husband, Farmer Saldean. In a region overrun by bandits and abandoned by Stormwind, she keeps her door open and provides warm meals to travelers in exchange for a little help around the homestead. While neighboring homesteads have been ransacked and burned by the Defias Brotherhood, the Saldeans manage to keep their hearth lit. Salma greets travelers with a warm demeanor and a hearty pot on the stove, always on the lookout for capable wanderers willing to assist around the farmstead. Survival in Westfall requires resourcefulness. Salma makes use of whatever the land provides to feed her family and visitors, teaching travelers how to prepare local specialties like Goretusk liver pie and her famous Westfall stew from wild boar, vultures, murlocs, and stray okra.

npc:sara-balloo.text: Sara Balloo. Sara Balloo is a grieving dwarven widow residing in the Military Ward of Ironforge. She spends her days mourning her late husband, Sully Balloo, clinging to any remnant or message left behind from his final days in service. Standing within the bustling Military Ward of Ironforge, Sara Balloo presents a somber contrast to the clatter of weaponry and martial drills. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her alone with memories and lingering grief. For Sara, closure arrives only through recovered words—a final letter carrying Sully's devotion across the mountains from the scene of his demise.

npc:sara-timberlain.text: Sara Timberlain. Sara Timberlain is a skilled tailor residing at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Known for her resourceful needlework with salvaged fabrics, she assists the war effort by stitching cloth and leather armaments for the Stormwind Army. Situated outside a small cottage on the western edge of the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain works tirelessly with needle and thread amidst the ambient noise of felling axes. Despite the remote nature of Eastvale and the looming threat of prowling wolves and murlocs, she provides hospitality and vital craftwork to travelers. Her talent for turning scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into durable gear has earned her official recognition, securing commissions to supply protective cloth and leather armaments directly to Stormwind's military forces.

npc:scooty.text: Scooty. Scooty is a goblin engineer operating out of the bustling pirate port of Booty Bay. Proclaiming himself a master of engineering, he maintains a delicate transponder setup linked directly to an experimental teleporter in the fallen city of Gnomeregan. His contraptions offer Horde operatives a direct, if perilous, technological bypass right into the heart of Dun Morogh. Operating amid the wharves and workshops of Booty Bay, Scooty holds court as one of the Steamwheedle Cartel's most ambitious tinkerers. While typical goblins obsess over gunpowder and explosives, Scooty turned his attention to instantaneous molecular transport. By calibrating complex transponder systems, he manages a direct operational link to a teleportation pad situated inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces looking to breach the subterranean gnome stronghold rely heavily on Scooty's tinkering to bypass treacherous Alliance territory altogether. Maintaining experimental goblin teleporters is rarely a dull enterprise. Scooty and his partner Sovik built the Transpolyporter 6000 after word reached them of a new gnomish rig in Gnomeregan, and by Scooty's own cheerful admission it has only exploded a dozen or so times. Despite the obvious physical perils involved in being dematerialized across continents, Scooty remains entirely confident in his genius, dismissing every catastrophic mechanical hiccup as merely a minor obstacle on the road to true innovation.

npc:scout-riell.text: Scout Riell. Scout Riell is a vigilant lookout stationed atop the watchtower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, she watches the surrounding plains for Defias activity and enlists adventurers to hunt down the masked outlaws. Perched high above Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell keeps watch over a region besieged by banditry and harvest golems. With Stormwind's royal army absent and the crown refusing aid, local defense falls entirely to the People's Militia. From her vantage point atop the stone tower, Riell tracks the brazen movements of the Defias Brotherhood and gathers proof of their crimes, calling on passing travelers to strip the bandits of their iconic red silk bandanas.

npc:scout-thaelrid.text: Argent Guard Thaelrid. Argent Guard Thaelrid is a wounded night elf scout sent by the Argent Dawn into the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Trapped near the Pool of Ask'ar, he bears witness to the dark alliance taking root between the naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult. When strange reports trickled out of the Zoram Strand concerning foul rites deep beneath the sea, the Argent Dawn took interest. Dedicated to watching for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, the order dispatched Scout Thaelrid to slip inside Blackfathom Deeps. His mission was simple: assess the depth of the threat, observe the movements within the flooded temple, and report back so the Dawn could decide where aid was most desperately needed.

npc:searn-firewarder.text: Searn Firewarder. Searn Firewarder is a Darkspear troll shaman trainer stationed inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He assists developing shamans across the Horde, directing them toward the trials needed to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air. Standing within the fortified walls of Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high command, Searn Firewarder serves as an elemental guide for aspiring shamans. While many Darkspear trolls commune with the spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals, Searn represents the bond troll shamans forge directly with the living elements of Kalimdor. He acts as an intermediary, directing initiates toward the far-flung mentors and rites required to earn the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air.

npc:seer-graytongue.text: Seer Graytongue. Seer Graytongue is a venerable tauren elder and spiritual guide residing on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Stationed near Camp Narache, he tests young braves undertaking their earliest tribal trials. Through rituals such as the Rite of Strength, he ensures that the youth honor the Earthmother before stepping into the wider world. Seer Graytongue makes his home atop Red Cloud Mesa, serving as an early instructor for aspiring tauren braves and spellweavers. As young adventurers set forth from Camp Narache, Graytongue oversees critical steps of their sacred passage, including the Rites of the Earthmother. By testing their resolve against the harsh plains and dangerous beasts of Mulgore, he instills the virtues of honor, patience, and reverence that every true tauren must carry into adulthood.

npc:seer-ravenfeather.text: Seer Ravenfeather. Seer Ravenfeather is a tauren shaman instructor stationed at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa. She guides fledging spiritualists through their early trials, helping them attune to the voices of the spirits and the land of Mulgore. Standing within the quiet shelters of Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather serves as a patient teacher for young tauren called to walk the shamanic path. The Red Cloud Mesa is a sacred proving ground, and Ravenfeather ensures that novice practitioners understand their duties before venturing into the wider expanses of Mulgore. She instructs them in the foundational rites needed to commune with elemental forces and honor the Earth Mother. Ravenfeather's primary charge is overseeing the initial spiritual steps of nascent shamans, directing them in the traditional rite known as the Call of Earth. Through her guidance, initiates prepare ceremonial saptas and seek communion with the earthen spirits nestled within the mesa's stony outcrops, forging a bond that anchors their elemental magic.

npc:seereth-stonebreak.text: Seereth Stonebreak. Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman who serves the Horde by monitoring the disturbances unsettling the land. Camped near the Greatwood Vale on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, she directs travelers to address environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor. Seereth Stonebreak is an orc dedicated to the harmony of the elements and the protection of Horde territories. Sent to Stonetalon after the land's spirits cried out against the goblins' plunder, she keeps her camp near the Greatwood Vale and maintains a vigilant eye over the landscape. Rather than retreat into despair, she uses her spiritual insight and knowledge of the wild frontier to guide adventurers against looming dangers. Seereth is acutely troubled by the turmoil wracking the Stonetalon range. Between the disruptive presence of ruthless goblin ventures and the unchecked operations of mechanical shredders cutting through ancient woodlands, the spiritual balance of the mountains has been severely fractured. She tasks Horde envoys with confronting these reckless invaders and consulting elder lorekeepers to heal the land's distress.

npc:senator-mehr-stonehallow.text: Senator Mehr Stonehallow. Senator Mehr Stonehallow is an Ironforge politician and member of the Explorers' League stationed at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. Rather than debating policy in the capital, he has traveled to the front lines to personally oversee the containment of the local trogg infestation. He enlists eager adventurers to cull the beasts before they overrun the quarry completely.
