While most members of the Ironforge Senate spend their days safely sequestered within the great stone halls of the capital, Senator Mehr Stonehallow prefers direct action. As a dwarf dedicated both to governance and the historical pursuits of the Explorers' League, he understands the practical dangers facing the realm. When vicious Rockjaw troggs began clawing out of the deep rock in Gol'Bolar Quarry, Stonehallow made the journey to the mining pit himself. Convinced that bureaucratic posturing will not save the workers, he offers bounties to capable travelers to eradicate the aggressive troggs and reclaim the quarry.

npc:senior-surveyor-fizzledowser.text: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is a goblin researcher working from Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He investigates disruptions around the local water supply and sends adventurers to look into the disappearance of Scrimshank.

npc:sentinel-arynia-cloudsbreak.text: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf guardian stationed within the serene groves of the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Charged with monitoring the sacred balance of the northern boughs, she keeps a wary watch over the glade's enchanted waters and woodland wildlife. Arynia Cloudsbreak serves the Sentinel army in one of the most secluded and mystical reaches of Teldrassil: the Oracle Glade. Amid ancient trees and ethereal springs, she carries out her watch far from the bustling avenues of Darnassus, ensuring the sanctity of the wilderness remains undisturbed. Despite Teldrassil's sacred birth, creeping disharmony has begun to unsettle its creatures. Arynia relies on passing adventurers and young night elves to investigate local disruptions, such as strange behaviors among the glade's wildlife and mystical phenomena around the enchanted springs.

npc:sentinel-aynasha.text: Sentinel Aynasha. Sentinel Aynasha is an operative of the night elven Sentinels serving in the wild borders of Darkshore. Tasked with scouting enemy movements and carrying critical intelligence, she regularly faces peril against hostile forces threatening northern Kalimdor. As a scout and archer for the Sentinels, Aynasha is deployed to the dangerous frontiers where night elven lands clash with hostile incursions. Carrying out stealth missions and bearing urgent dispatches across rugged terrain, she relies on her marksmanship and survival instincts to evade enemy patrols and survive deep within contested territory.

npc:sentinel-elissa-starbreeze.text: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze. Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is a night elf guardian stationed in Auberdine along the misty coast of Darkshore. Operating from the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she monitors growing regional threats and directs travelers toward pressing concerns in the wilderness. While many Sentinels patrol the foggy coastline and woodlands directly, Elissa Starbreeze coordinates defensive efforts from Auberdine. Stationed on the upper level of the building just northeast across the bridge from the town inn, she stays alert to unusual disturbances in Darkshore. Her tasks frequently point adventurers toward remote points of interest, including the mysterious Tower of Althalaxx looming far to the north, ensuring that shadowy incursions do not take the coastal settlement unawares.

npc:sentinel-farsong.text: Sentinel Farsong. Sentinel Farsong is a night elf sentinel stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Serving as a crucial liaison for the Silverwing Sentinels, she coordinates intelligence and combat efforts against the encroaching Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch. Standing vigil within Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong is deeply involved in the defense of Ashenvale's southern border. With the Warsong clan continuously harvesting lumber and pushing deeper into ancestral night elf territories, she mobilizes Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and ensures field reports reach Silverwing command. Her duties center on rallying volunteers to check the Horde's territorial expansion and preserve the sacred woods.

npc:sentinel-onaeya.text: Sentinel Onaeya. Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian stationed at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore. Tasked with holding the line against encroaching perils, she rallies capable Alliance adventurers to safeguard the forest and aid fellow sentinels. Maestra's Post serves as a critical wayside outpost along the road from Darkshore into the dense, contested canopy of Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya stands guard outside the settlement's main lodge, keeping a vigilant watch over travelers and coordinating defensive actions. Between hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions, sentinels like Onaeya represent the first line of defense for night elf settlements in the region. Onaeya receives news of Sentinel Aynasha, who is attacked by furbolgs while carrying an important message through Darkshore. She rewards adventurers who protect the poisoned sentinel until her antidote takes effect.

npc:sentinel-selarin.text: Sentinel Selarin. Sentinel Selarin is a night elf scout dispatched to the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Acting as an emissary for the defenders of Ashenvale, she seeks reinforcements to help stem the rising perils threatening the ancient forest. As tensions and dark threats mount across Ashenvale, the garrison there has found its resources stretched to the breaking point. Under the direction of Raene Wolfrunner, Sentinel Selarin traveled north along the forest road into Darkshore. Her mission was straightforward: seek out Terenthis in Auberdine and request assistance from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast. Upon arriving in Auberdine, Selarin found Terenthis thoroughly consumed by local duties and unable to personally answer the call. Rather than returning empty-handed, Selarin resolved to remain in town and enlist capable travelers passing through Darkshore. She directs proven adventurers south toward Astranaar, urging them to lend their blades and spells to Raene Wolfrunner's beleaguered forces.

npc:sentinel-thenysil.text: Sentinel Thenysil. Sentinel Tara Thenysil is a night elf sentinel stationed in Astranaar within the ancient forest of Ashenvale. Vigilant over the surrounding wilderness, she keeps close tabs on military operations in the region and coordinates scouts watching neighboring territories. Her attention is particularly focused on allied movements pushing south into the contested Stonetalon Mountains. From her post in the fortified settlement of Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps secure Ashenvale against growing hostility. Night elf holdings throughout the region face relentless encroachment, making communications between distant outposts vital. While much of the local garrison focuses directly on defending the forest road, Thenysil directs Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale's borders to ensure distant allies remain supported. Thenysil maintains a close personal and military friendship with Kaela Shadowspear, an operative deployed south into the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains. Learning that Kaela was dispatched alongside an eccentric gnome mage, Thenysil considered the unorthodox pairing an unmistakable sign of serious trouble brewing in the peaks. Wary of what dangers her comrade might face, she recruits capable adventurers to journey south, deliver support, and report on the unfolding mission.

npc:sentinel-tysha-moonblade.text: Sentinel Tysha Moonblade. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is a night elf scout stationed along the main road of Darkshore, just west of the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran. Tasked with patrolling the troubled coastal wilderness, she directs travelers and recruits aid to investigate the restless spirits haunting the shattered elven settlements nearby. Standing sentinel along the overgrown highway of Darkshore, Tysha Moonblade keeps a vigilant eye over an increasingly unstable land. Directly to her east lie the haunted remnants of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Recognizing that Auberdine's limited defenses are stretched thin by threats across the coast, Tysha enlists capable adventurers passing by to uncover the history behind Ameth'Aran's tragic fall and put down the restless dead.

npc:sentinel-velene-starstrike.text: Sentinel Velene Starstrike. Sentinel Velene Starstrike is a night elf guardian stationed at Silverwind Refuge in central Ashenvale. Tasked with protecting the sanctuary and the surrounding waters, she confronts encroaching unnatural threats such as rogue elementals and foul sorcerers. Her vigilance helps safeguard the ancient woodland from corrupting magical interference. Stationed beside the clear waters of Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike maintains a watchful vigil from Silverwind Refuge. Like many night elf sentinels scattered throughout Ashenvale, her primary duty is preserving the balance of the forest and repelling threats to elven sanctuaries. The serene grove serves as a vital rest stop for travelers traversing the central woods, making her presence essential to the area's ongoing safety. The peace around Silverwind Refuge is fragile. Velene keeps close watch over Mystral Lake, where erratic elemental spirits and reckless mage summoners disrupt the natural rhythm of the wilderness. Through her direction, champions are dispatched to suppress rogue water elementals and put an end to the careless practitioners disturbing the spirits of the land.

npc:serge-hinott.text: Serge Hinott. Serge Hinott is a Forsaken alchemist stationed in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Working closely alongside Apothecary Lydon, he assists the Royal Apothecary Society with brewing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents essential to the Forsaken war effort. Positioned beside Apothecary Lydon in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott plays a crucial supporting role for Forsaken operations in Hillsbrad Foothills. While Lydon focuses on broader chemical development and aggressive plague research against neighboring human settlements like Southshore, Hinott manages specialized brewing tasks. His expertise includes preparing restorative salves and critical antidotes required when field agents and scouts encounter dangerous poisons and toxic mishaps.

npc:shanda.text: Shanda. Shanda is a night elf priestess and mentor located within the hollow trunk of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Serving the Sisterhood of Elune, she instructs novice night elf priests in the fundamental prayers, wards, and rites of the Moon Goddess. Her guidance helps fledgling acolytes balance the light of Elune with their duties in defending Teldrassil. Standing within the tranquil sanctuary of Aldrassil, Shanda serves as one of the first spiritual guides for young night elves dedicated to Elune. While the druids tend to the waking roots and boughs of Teldrassil, priestesses like Shanda ensure that the spiritual heart of the Kaldorei remains tethered to the White Lady. She instructs new initiates on channeling lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the boughs of the World Tree. When young priests awaken to their calling in Shadowglen, they are directed to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve and provides them with blessed regalia and basic incantations. Under her tutelage, students learn that a priestess of the Kaldorei must be both a gentle hand to the wounded and a steadfast shield against the shadows.

npc:shandris-feathermoon.text: Shandris Feathermoon. Shandris Feathermoon is the General of the Sentinel Army and, for ten thousand years, Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand. She now commands night elf military forces throughout Kalimdor from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle off the coast of Feralas. Shandris Feathermoon is one of the oldest defenders of the night elves. For ten thousand years she has served at Tyrande Whisperwind's side as the high priestess's right hand among the Sentinels, through the long vigil that followed the Sundering. Following the Great Sundering and the founding of the Sentinels, Shandris became an indispensable commander within the night elf military. Today, General Feathermoon serves as the supreme field commander of the Sentinel army. Stationed on Sardor Isle, she oversees Feathermoon Stronghold, an imposing elven fortress that keeps watch over the primal wilds of Feralas. From this island outpost, she monitors the encroaching threats of savage gnolls, lingering Gordunni ogres, hate-fueled satyrs, and the expanding power of the Horde in southern Kalimdor.

npc:shari-stilwell.text: Shari Stilwell. Shari Stilwell is a Forsaken paladin trainer stationed in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Bearing a surname shared with notable figures in the Eastern Kingdoms, she instructs Forsaken who take up the mantle of holy warriors. Her presence marks a rare and unconventional discipline among the undead under the Banshee Queen. Found among the blight-touched buildings of Brill, Shari Stilwell stands out as a mentor to Forsaken holy warriors. While the holy Light is excruciating to the undead, Shari guides fledgling Forsaken who endure that agonizing path. She aids newcomers seeking their footing in Tirisfal Glades through their early training and adjustments, offering guidance to those looking to secure a place within the Forsaken kingdom. Shari shares her family name with several living figures scattered across the southern kingdoms, including Daphne, Merissa, and the renowned smith Jordan Stilwell. Whether she was torn away from these kin during the fall of Lordaeron or shares only a distant lineage remains an unspoken tragedy of the Scourge's devastation.

npc:shelene-rhobart.text: Shelene Rhobart. Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworking trainer stationed along the road in Tirisfal Glades. Operating out of a Deathguard waystation, she supplies cured hides and leathercraft training to support the Forsaken's military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands. Shelene Rhobart plies her trade at a Deathguard waystation, an outpost situated southeast of Brill along the main road toward the ruins of Lordaeron. Even in undeath, practical crafts remain essential for survival and war. Shelene works with animal pelts collected from the prowling beasts of Tirisfal, refining tough hides into armor, straps, and field gear to supply local Forsaken patrols contending with both the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.

npc:shindrell-swiftfire.text: Shindrell Swiftfire. Shindrell Swiftfire is a night elf sentinel and scout stationed in Astranaar, the heart of night elf operations in Ashenvale. Keenly aware of shifting perils along Kalimdor's western reaches, she directs capable Alliance adventurers toward gathering threats on the coastline and nearby mountain passes. Her duties make her an essential hub for coordinating local defense against emerging oceanic and wild menaces. From Astranaar's winding walkways, Shindrell Swiftfire serves as an alert observer of Ashenvale's broader frontiers. While the forest's Sentinels are constantly pressured by the Horde's logging incursions from the east and south, Shindrell keeps her eyes fixed on dangers that lie beyond the immediate woodland front. She acts as a vital liaison for travelers arriving from Darkshore or heading out toward the jagged ridges of Stonetalon, ensuring no sudden menace strikes Astranaar undefended from the flank. Among Shindrell's primary concerns is the troubled Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwestern shore. The sudden emergence of hostile naga crawling from the ocean depths poses a grave mystery and direct threat to the Kaldorei settlements. By dispatching seasoned fighters to investigate the shoreline and coordinate with scouts closer to the scene, Shindrell works to contain the serpentine invaders before they secure a permanent foothold on ancient night elf lands.

npc:shoni-the-shilent.text: Shoni the Shilent. Shoni the Shilent is an industrious gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. As commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew, she directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to salvage the power supply of a goblin shredder, fuel for the machines she hopes will break a path back into Gnomeregan. Operating out of the smoky workshops of the Dwarven District, Shoni represents gnomish strategic ingenuity far from the lost halls of Gnomeregan. Her engineering plans are ambitious. With Gnomeregan in the hands of the troggs, Shoni is organizing an underground assault to retake it, and she sends operatives into the subterranean tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs. Shoni's plan rests on the gnomes' own gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy drilling machines meant to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan and open the way for a gnomish assault. They lack the power to do it, so she wants the intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. Later, she also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan itself to tear apart its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.

npc:sicco-thermaplugg.text: Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Mekgineer Thermaplugg is the self-proclaimed ruler of ruined Gnomeregan and the greatest traitor in gnomish history. Once the trusted chief advisor of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, he orchestrated the catastrophic irradiation of the underground city in a twisted bid to seize power. Now thoroughly deranged and transformed into a leper gnome, he commands the irradiated halls from within a massive mechanical battle suit. Mekgineer Thermaplugg served for many years as chief advisor to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who trusted him completely. All the while, Thermaplugg secretly coveted the office of High Tinker. What finally drove him to betray that trust, whether power or wealth, not even Mekkatorque can say; the High Tinker can only note that Thermaplugg would have had both in time.

npc:sida.text: Sida. Sida is a dwarven resident of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Known for her estranged marriage to Einar Stonegrip, she spends her days in the port town while dealing with personal misadventures out in the surrounding marshes. Sida resides in the bustling Alliance port of Menethil Harbor, living apart from her husband, Einar Stonegrip. Their relationship is strained enough that Einar flatly refuses to travel to Menethil so long as Sida remains in town. Despite keeping to the coastal settlement, Sida occasionally ventures out into the dangers of the Wetlands, having recently suffered the misfortune of losing her personal bag during an expedition out toward Ironbeard's Tomb.

npc:sirra-von-indi.text: Sirra Von'Indi. Sirra Von'Indi is the resident historian of Darkshire, stationed within the town hall amid stacks of forgotten records. Versed in ancient languages and local history, he assists the township in deciphering mysterious documents and uncovering the dark past of Duskwood. Sirra Von'Indi serves as Darkshire's foremost scholar, keeping watch over the settlement's archives from inside the Darkshire Town Hall. While the town guard focuses on the immediate threats lurking in the woods, Sirra turns his attention to the written word, translating cryptic texts and preserving the fading history of Grand Hamlet before the shadow fell across the region.

npc:sister-aquinne.text: Sister Aquinne. Sister Aquinne is an acolyte of Elune residing within the serene Temple Gardens of Darnassus. A novice priestess, she is studying under the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. Sister Aquinne has dedicated herself to the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. Stationed in the tranquil Temple Gardens beneath the shadow of the Temple of the Moon, she continues her studies under the guidance of the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest was in need of help, it was Aquinne who sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.

npc:skorn-whitecloud.text: Skorn Whitecloud. Skorn Whitecloud is an aging tauren hunter residing at Bloodhoof Village in the rolling plains of Mulgore. He guides young hunters in understanding their relationship with the land's predators and aids travelers who cross paths with Mulgore's lurking dangers. Living at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud is an old hunter who now serves as an instructor in the ways of the hunt. His primary role is instilling respect for the wild creatures of the plains. He tests aspiring hunters by sending them after the claws of Mulgore's cunning flatland prowlers, to be shown to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, ensuring that those who take up the bow or spear understand the balance between predator and prey.

npc:skuerto.text: Skuerto. Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Sent there by Archmage Malin alongside Apprentice Kryten, he aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure magical relics on Malin's behalf. Skuerto, a dwarf of Ironforge, works as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane. Despite the harsh conditions of the Highlands, Skuerto takes considerable pride in his wilderness scouting and reacts poorly to anyone questioning his competence. His work regularly brushes up against regional perils, from the hostile Syndicate and Boulderfist ogres to dangerous ancient entities tied to the land.

npc:smith-argus.text: Smith Argus. Smith Argus is the resident blacksmith and trainer stationed in the heart of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. From his open-air forge near the Lion's Pride Inn, he repairs traveler gear, teaches novice smiths their fundamentals, and coordinates with craftsmen across southern Azeroth. His network ties Goldshire's local trade directly to logistical hubs like Stormwind and distant frontiers like Redridge. Situated just outside the Lion's Pride Inn, Smith Argus maintains one of the busiest anvils in Elwynn Forest. While Goldshire faces growing perils from nearby gnolls, kobolds, and Defias bandits, Argus keeps local militia and passing adventurers properly equipped. In addition to mending dented armor and forging sturdy implements, he serves as a blacksmithing trainer, initiating fledgling craftsmen into the fundamentals of working copper and bronze. Argus is not an isolated village smith; his workshop is a vital link in the Kingdom of Stormwind's regional supply chain. When craftsmen in neighboring settlements require specialized gear or raw materials, they look to Goldshire's central position. Farrier Verner Osgood in Redridge relies on Argus for shipments of crafted horseshoes to keep pack animals and cavalry moving, while metalworkers in Stormwind's Dwarven District regularly coordinate deliveries through him.

npc:solm-hargrin.text: Solm Hargrin. Solm Hargrin is the rogue trainer stationed within Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A pragmatic dwarf who values honor amongst thieves, he instructs novice dwarven and gnomish scoundrels in the art of subterfuge. He firmly believes that covert operatives will prove vital as geopolitical tensions simmer across Azeroth. Tucked away in the dwarven stronghold of Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin watches the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley with a keen, calculating eye. While Ironforge relies heavily on the brute strength of its mountaineers and warriors, Hargrin understands that some threats require a quieter, sharper touch. He welcomes budding rogues of both dwarven and gnomish heritage, deciphering coded missives for them and drilling them in essential techniques like Eviscerate. Above all, Hargrin champions a creed of professional loyalty and honor among thieves, preparing his pupils for an increasingly volatile world where subtle knives often shape the fate of nations.

npc:sprite-darter.text: Sprite Darter. Sprite Darters are small, iridescent faerie dragons native to the lush canopy of Feralas. Revered for their innate spiritual and magical qualities, they flit gracefully among the ancient trees. Recently, these rare creatures have become targets for local Grimtotem tauren who seek to capture and exploit them. Sprite Darters are elusive, winged woodland beasts native to the ancient forests of Feralas. Characterized by their gleaming, iridescent wings and mysterious spiritual essence, they embody the whimsical yet fierce magical ecology of Kalimdor's deep forests. Though generally peaceful and shy, their innate resistance to magical forces and natural power make them significant to those attuned to the wilderness. In recent times, the reclusive Sprite Darters have faced an unprecedented threat. The aggressive Grimtotem tauren clan inhabiting Feralas has begun rounding up and caging large numbers of these rare creatures for enigmatic purposes. Concerned night elves like Kindal Moonweaver actively recruit allies to disrupt the cages and liberate the trapped hatchlings before the Grimtotem bend them to their will. Beyond night elf efforts to safeguard them, the darters have caught the eye of outside observers studying primal power. Witch Doctor Uzer'i, a troll spiritualist operating out of Camp Mojache, takes a keen interest in the natural energies and muisek contained within the Sprite Darters, seeking their essence to unravel the unique magic thriving throughout Feralas.

npc:stitches.text: Stitches. Stitches is a colossal, stitched-together undead abomination stalking Duskwood's main thoroughfare. His march threatens travelers, the Night Watch, and the town of Darkshire. Stitches is an undead abomination assembled from harvested corpses and unholy sorcery. Appearing near Abercrombie's shack northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, the lumbering monstrosity immediately sets out eastward along the road toward Darkshire. Imbued with immense physical strength and relentless malice, Stitches tears through any Night Watch checkpoints stationed along the thoroughfare—including the defense camp across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the outpost outside the Rotting Orchard—bringing outright slaughter to unwary travelers and town defenders alike.

npc:supervisor-raelen.text: Supervisor Raelen. Supervisor Raelen oversees timber operations at the Eastvale Logging Camp on the eastern edge of Elwynn Forest. She is responsible for managing the local laborers, maintaining daily logging quotas, and ensuring that harvested lumber safely makes its way into Stormwind's supply chains. Located in the heart of Eastvale Logging Camp near Marshal Patterson and the camp's wood wagons, Supervisor Raelen directs the labor force tasked with harvesting timber for the kingdom. Operating a lumber camp on the border of the Redridge Mountains carries significant logistical challenges, from coordinating weary woodcutters to dealing with wildlife and bandit interference that threatens production quotas. Despite the hazards of the surrounding woods, Raelen focuses squarely on getting timber gathered, processed, and bundled for transport.

npc:suzetta-gallina.text: Suzetta Gallina. Suzetta Gallina is a member of the Gallina family, purveyors of fine vintages in Stormwind City. She can be found inside the family's wine shop tucked along the Canals, helping manage the business and spread word of their stock to thirsty patrons across the city. Situated along the scenic waterways of Stormwind's Canal District, the Gallina Winery caters to citizens seeking quality vintages imported or crafted across the kingdom. Suzetta Gallina helps oversee daily life in the establishment, maintaining the family legacy of supplying taverns, nobles, and common folk with wine. While not a public figure of high politics, her presence represents the everyday commercial heartbeat that keeps the capital thriving amidst broader troubles.

npc:syral-bladeleaf.text: Syral Bladeleaf. Syral Bladeleaf is a night elf resident of Dolanaar in Teldrassil who serves as a liaison for the Council of the Forest. She guides young adventurers who arrive from Shadowglen, directing them toward local caretakers, herbalists, and elders who watch over the crown's delicate boughs. Found standing near the heart of Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf helps organize local affairs in the shadow of Teldrassil's canopy. Acting on behalf of the Council of the Forest, she directs newly arrived night elves to community leaders and herbalists across the village and the nearby wilderness. Through her guidance, travelers connect with the botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth and replenish supplies for the village elders. Syral works on behalf of the Council of the Forest in Dolanaar. Her responsibilities keep her focused on communal welfare, ensuring that medicinal elixirs reach those in need and that any disruptions in the local ecosystem receive swift attention.

npc:syurna.text: Syurna. Syurna is a night elf rogue trainer found nestled among the foliage of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. She mentors aspiring scouts, spies, and covert operatives of the Kaldorei, guiding newly trained rogues on missions that test their stealth and cunning. While Darnassus celebrates the overt martial might of the Sentinels and the spiritual wisdom of the Sisterhood of Elune, the Kaldorei have always relied on shadows and stealth. Located in the Cenarion Enclave, Syurna acts as a trainer and mentor for those who walk an unseen path. She instructs rogues in the fine arts of evasion, lockpicking, and lethal strikes, ensuring that Darnassus possesses sharp eyes and silent blades to defend Teldrassil. Syurna does not merely offer theoretical advice from the safety of the enclave; she tests the readiness of young operatives. Through tasks such as directing promising initiates into deeper fieldwork, she tests whether an operative has the instincts necessary to survive outside the boughs of the World Tree and serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.

npc:tabetha.text: Tabetha. Tabetha is a reclusive, powerful human mage dwelling deep within Dustwallow Marsh at an isolated farmstead in the Quagmire. Far from the politics of Dalaran or Theramore, she instructs aspiring spellcasters and aids those seeking mastery over potent arcane and occult relics. Hidden away in the sodden expanse of Dustwallow Marsh north of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a secluded shack alongside her apprentices. Surrounding herself with alchemical vials and ancient tomes, she has deliberately chosen solitude over the academic hierarchies of the Eastern Kingdoms. Despite her remote location, her mastery of the arcane is renowned enough that spellcasters across Kalimdor brave beasts and mire alike to seek her guidance. Tabetha stands notably apart from factional hostilities. While human by birth, she turns away neither Alliance nor Horde initiates who demonstrate the will to learn, providing tutelage to mages and assisting warlocks with dangerous bindings such as the Orb of Orahil. Her past connects her to figures like Menara Voidrender, revealing an extensive history with esoteric magic that transcends simple faction allegiance.

npc:tai-jin.text: Tai'jin. Tai'jin is a Darkspear troll priest trainer stationed within the barracks of Razor Hill in Durotar. She guides fledgling priests of the Horde, introducing Darkspear initiates to traditional troll rites such as the Hex of Weakness. Stationed inside the sturdy barracks of Razor Hill, Tai'jin serves as a spiritual mentor for young priests stepping out into Durotar. While orcs predominantly turn to shamanism or dark warlock arts, the Darkspear trolls bring their own distinct communion with the spirits and loas to the Horde. Tai'jin offers foundational teachings in the priesthood, ensuring that new acolytes understand both the balance of light and shadow and the spiritual heritage unique to troll culture.

npc:taiga-wisemane.text: Taiga Wisemane. Taiga Wisemane is a tauren elder residing in Shadowprey Village along the rugged western coast of Desolace. Watchful of demonic meddling across the barren wastes, he works to thwart the Burning Blade cult entrenched in the region. He directs Horde champions to disrupt demonic rituals and seal open gateways before the Burning Legion gains ground. Though Shadowprey Village is predominantly a Darkspear troll fishing settlement tucked away against the ocean, Taiga Wisemane has taken up station there to monitor the dark sorceries stirring across Desolace. He remains acutely aware of the spiritual corruption bleeding into the soil, keeping his focus fixed eastward where shadow cults and demonic remnants fester among ancient ruins.

npc:takar-the-seer.text: Takar the Seer. Takar the Seer is an elusive human hermit encamped deep within the Barrens, east of Camp Taurajo. Despite sitting entirely within Horde-dominated territory, he maintains allegiance to the Alliance and assists certain travelers with esoteric occult knowledge. Dwelling alone beneath a simple tent east of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer seems out of place amid the dry plains of the Barrens. Surrounding lands are watched constantly by tauren braves and orc patrols, yet Takar remains undisturbed in his remote clearing. Hostile to curious Horde interlopers but rarely eager to initiate violence, he keeps a sharp eye on the horizon and prefers solitude. His isolated existence suggests deliberate seclusion, far from the bustling politics of Stormwind. Though solitary, Takar is not entirely detached from the wider world. Initiates of darker arts—particularly Alliance warlocks sent from the Eastern Kingdoms—seek his cryptic guidance when attempting to bind dangerous otherworldly entities. His deep understanding of unseen forces and soulcraft makes his remote camp a vital, if perilous, pilgrimage site for practitioners looking to bind and command demons.

npc:takata-steelblade.text: Takata Steelblade. Takata Steelblade is an orc warrior stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Dispatched from Orgrimmar by Keldran alongside Maurin Bonesplitter, he spearheads the Horde's local campaign against demonic corruption. His primary focus is eradicating the regional satyr population affiliated with the sinister Burning Blade. Takata Steelblade was sent from the capital to Desolace under direct orders from Keldran, an influential figure in Orgrimmar committed to uncovering and purging demonic subversion. Operating out of the isolated Tauren encampment of Ghost Walker Post, Takata coordinates military efforts against the Legion-aligned forces plaguing the barren wastes. While his companion Maurin Bonesplitter attempts to track and dismantle the clandestine Burning Blade cultists directly, Takata focuses on their demonic allies: the satyrs. Takata has orchestrated aggressive strikes against Desolace's corrupted satyrs, decimating their ranks to break the cult's local power structure and halt their spreading taint.

npc:tal.text: Tal. Tal is the primary wind rider master of Thunder Bluff, tending the city's aerial roost high above the plains of Mulgore. He provides seasoned wyverns to Horde travelers looking to traverse the vast reaches of Kalimdor. Perched upon the central mesa of Thunder Bluff, Tal manages the vital aerial thoroughfare connecting the tauren capital to the rest of the Horde. From his perch, he tends to the loyal wind riders, or wyverns, ensuring they are healthy, well-fed, and prepared for long-distance journeys across Kalimdor's rugged landscapes. Whether sending messengers down to Camp Taurajo or dispatching scouts across the Barrens to Orgrimmar, Tal maintains an indispensable lifeline that keeps the towering mesa city in constant touch with its allies.

npc:talen.text: Talen. Talen is a night elf amateur archaeologist encamped near the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Despite the constant danger posed by nearby naga and Horde outposts, he is dedicated to recovering ancient kaldorei relics buried along the coast. Perched at a small camp on the edge of the Zoram Strand, Talen spends his days pursuing historical curiosities rather than waging war. While the wilderness of Ashenvale is fraught with territorial skirmishes and hostile shoreline denizens, Talen remains focused on gathering long-lost treasures from the ruins submerged beneath the waves and sands. He relies heavily on passing adventurers to brave the savage Wrathtail naga and retrieve elusive artifacts—including pristine statuettes and the Ring of Zoram held by the naga leader Ruuzel.

npc:tallow.text: Tallow. Tallow is a Forsaken warrior stationed in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Serving the Dark Lady and the Horde, he watches over the contested front lines, helping organize strikes against local Alliance threats. Situated in the heart of Tarren Mill, Tallow stands among the Forsaken and Horde forces holding the line in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The region is a powder keg of conflict, caught between nearby Southshore humans, wandering Syndicate outlaws, and hostile wildlife. Tallow helps direct capable adventurers into the field, testing their strength against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands before sending them on to aid the besieged outpost of Hammerfall.

npc:talvash-del-kissel.text: Talvash del Kissel. Talvash del Kissel is a down-on-his-luck gnome jeweler who fled the fall of Gnomeregan and now resides in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. Plagued by debt and persistent rumors following the loss of his home, he seeks capable adventurers to help recover lost treasures and restore shattered relics. His keen eye for precious gems and ancient baubles makes him a valuable contact for those plumbing the depths of Uldaman. Once a respected jeweler in the technological heart of Gnomeregan, Talvash saw his livelihood obliterated alongside his home when the troggs overran the underground city. Escaping with the surviving refugees to the dwarven capital of Ironforge, he set up camp in the Mystic Ward. Unfortunately, relocation did not treat him kindly. Rumors of questionable dealings and unpaid obligations quickly piled up, sinking the craftsman into deep financial distress. Unable to rebuild his trade through conventional means, Talvash relies on freelance adventurers to retrieve lost assets and salvage his ruined reputation. Despite his misfortunes, Talvash has lost none of his gem-cutting precision or appraisal acumen. When explorers in the Badlands uncover an ancient, shattered necklace deep within the Titan vault of Uldaman, Talvash proves to be one of the few craftsmen in the Eastern Kingdoms capable of understanding its intricate enchantments. Restoring such power requires rare components and painstaking labor, but Talvash is eager to ply his trade—both to clear his debts and to prove his enduring skill.

npc:tammra-windfield.text: Tammra Windfield. Tammra Windfield is a tauren resident of Sun Rock Retreat, nestled within the heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. Deeply attuned to the balance of the land, she guides Horde travelers in honoring the natural cycle of renewal and keeping hope alive amid the peaks. Her concerns lie with both the health of the untamed wilderness and the safety of her kin. Sun Rock Retreat serves as a vital sanctuary for the Horde within the craggy peaks of Stonetalon, surrounded by hostile harpies, Venture Company loggers, and lurking predators. Tammra Windfield stands among the settlement's caretakers, keeping a watchful eye on both the mountain wilderness and travelers who cross its threshold. Her gentle demeanor belies the resolve necessary to maintain a home in such rugged terrain. Like many of her people, Tammra honors the Earth Mother by observing the constant rhythm of growth and decay in nature. Through the tasks she entrusts to travelers—such as tending the cycle of rebirth and bringing forth new life—she works to counter the ravages that conflict and exploitation bring upon Stonetalon. To Tammra, protecting the land requires active healing, ensuring that life flourishes even in scarred mountain soil. Beyond her spiritual duties to the surrounding wild, Tammra bears deep concern for the companions and kin who brave the treacherous trails of the Stonetalon Mountains. When word spreads that travelers or family have vanished along the crags, she is among the first to seek out reliable aid. For Tammra, the endurance of Sun Rock Retreat depends as much on mutual protection and loyalty as it does on harmony with nature.

npc:tannok-frosthammer.text: Tannok Frosthammer. Tannok Frosthammer is a dwarven resident found at Thunderbrew Distillery outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He serves as an anxious recipient of goods coming from Coldridge Valley, deeply troubled by how trogg attacks have cut off the roads to Anvilmar. Stationed around the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Tannok Frosthammer keeps a watchful eye on incoming deliveries and local tidings. The sudden surge of troggs swarming Coldridge Pass has severed normal transit from Coldridge Valley, leaving Tannok cut off from regular communication with the settlement at Anvilmar. Relying on couriers like the gnome tinkerer Hands Springsprocket to ferry vital supplies and news through the perilous, snowy mountain pass, Tannok represents the quiet worry shared by many Bronzebeards as subterranean threats crawl closer to their doorsteps.

npc:tarindrella.text: Tarindrella. Tarindrella is a dryad found watching over the sheltered woods of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. As a daughter of Cenarius, she works closely with night elf protectors to investigate the unnatural corruption afflicting the World Tree's wildlife. Dryads are fierce caretakers of nature, born of the demigod Cenarius. While many remain deep within ancient Kalimdor forests like Ashenvale, Tarindrella dwells in the protected glade of Shadowglen atop the boughs of Teldrassil. She acts as a vital bridge between the wild spirits and young night elf defenders taking their first steps outside Aldrassil. Her primary concern is the lingering taint creeping into the forest, tasking reliable adventurers with driving back local pests and gathering clues about the root of the affliction. Despite Teldrassil's grandeur as the new crown of the night elf people, its pristine groves harbor an unexpected sickness. The once-peaceful furbolgs have deserted their homes to gather as the Gnarlpine tribe, and grells and grellkin tainted by wicked Fel Moss infest the hills around Shadowglen. Tarindrella suspects the Fel Moss behind these changes and directs initiates to confront the grells and bring back samples, seeking to stem the corruption before it can overtake the sanctuary of the young grove.

npc:tarrel-rockweaver.text: Tarrel Rockweaver. Tarrel Rockweaver is an anxious dwarven husband stationed on the bridge leading into Menethil Harbor. Deeply worried for his wife Merrin, an archaeologist who ventured inland with Whelgar's excavation team, he watches the road hoping for news of her safety. While trade and military shipments flow through Menethil Harbor, Tarrel Rockweaver keeps an anxious vigil at the bridge on the edge of town. His wife, Merrin Rockweaver, joined Prospector Whelgar's prestigious archaeological expedition deeper into the Wetlands. When violent raptors overran the excavation site and cut off regular communication, Tarrel was left stranded in town, begging passing travelers to scout east toward Whelgar's Excavation Site to ensure she survived the disaster.

npc:tatternack-steelforge.text: Tatternack Steelforge. Tatternack Steelforge is an orc smith stationed out in the harsh savanna of the Barrens, offering work to travelers who can handle raw metal and dangerous frontier fauna. Adept in the ways of iron and fire, he looks to study local ores and arm Horde forces against threats across the plains. In the arid sprawl of the Barrens, keeping Horde outposts armed is no small task. Tatternack Steelforge brings the traditional metalworking expertise of his people to the frontier, seeking both practical weapons and unusual geological specimens to bolster the Horde's foothold against wild beasts, centaur raiders, and hostile quilboar.

npc:tenaron-stormgrip.text: Tenaron Stormgrip. Tenaron Stormgrip is a night elf guide high within Aldrassil, the central tree of Shadowglen. He teaches young kaldorei the recent history of their people while asking them to gather moonwell water. Perched upon the winding wooden platforms of Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip stands as an early mentor to young night elves stepping forth from the boughs of Shadowglen. From his vantage point, he monitors the health of the local woods and the vital moonwells that sustain them. His role is to instruct novices in understanding their profound spiritual connection to the World Tree. Tenaron begins the journey known as Crown of the Earth. He sends initiates to gather a phial of water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil, teaching them what followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. The journey continues through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

npc:teronis-corpse.text: Teronis' Corpse. Teronis' Corpse lies on a secluded island within Lake Falathim in western Ashenvale. Before his untimely demise, this night elf scout was dispatched from Astranaar on a crucial mission to recover Dartol's Rod to aid in cleansing the forest. Sent forth by Raene Wolfrunner from the settlement of Astranaar, Teronis was tasked with recovering the lost rod of Dartol, an ancient night elf relic capable of purifying corrupted woodland magic. His search brought him deep into the waters of Lake Falathim, but the journey turned fatal when hostile murlocs swarmed the island. Teronis fell in battle, leaving his journal behind and the rod's radiant gemstone plundered by the lake's aggressive amphibians.

npc:thadius-grimshade.text: Thadius Grimshade. Thadius Grimshade is a Wildhammer dwarf diviner dwelling within the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. Though he parted ways with Aerie Peak long ago to study esoteric and darker magical arts, he remains loyal to his kin at heart. Unlike most Wildhammer dwarves who prefer the open skies and roaring winds of the Hinterlands, Thadius Grimshade makes his home inside Nethergarde Keep. Driven by a thirst for arcane divination and darker mystic lore, he relocated to the edge of the tainted Blasted Lands to pursue his esoteric studies. Despite his brooding discipline and separation from his clan, he retains a deep fondness for his homeland and gryphonkind, offering his rare scrying talents to those who come seeking aid on behalf of Aerie Peak.

npc:thalia-amberhide.text: Thalia Amberhide. Thalia Amberhide is a tauren residing at Freewind Post in the jagged canyon of Thousand Needles. A loyal friend to her kin, she waits with mounting concern for the safe return of Lakota Windsong from the clutches of the Grimtotem clan. Perched atop the towering bluffs of Freewind Post, Thalia Amberhide is a quiet presence among the bustling tauren settlement. Her heart is heavy with worry for her close companion, Lakota Windsong, who was taken captive by Arnak Grimtotem and his treacherous kin. Thalia relies on passing Horde adventurers who brave the canyon depths to find Lakota, break her bonds, and guide her safely back up the lifts to the haven of the mesa.

npc:tharek-blackstone.text: Tharek Blackstone. Tharek Blackstone is a hardworking toolsmith residing in Kharanos, in the snowy heart of Dun Morogh. Known for supplying heavy hardware to local craftsmen, his primary patron is Beldin Steelgrill of Steelgrill's Depot. Though constantly busy at his trade, he also serves as a reliable point of contact for travelers seeking work around the settlement. Situated amidst the cold drifts of Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone keeps busy turning out reliable dwarven tools. Between repairing gear for the locals and supplying larger operations, he rarely finds a moment to rest. His biggest headache—and most reliable customer—is Beldin Steelgrill, whose mechanostrider depot just outside town demands a steady stream of heavy wrenches, gears, and replacement implements. To keep his forge running without falling behind on deliveries, Tharek often hires wandering travelers to haul newly finished tool crates over to the depot for him. Beyond his trade at the anvil, Tharek carries considerable respect among the folk of Dun Morogh. While he holds no formal military title, his standing in town makes him an approachable liaison for odd jobs, supply runs, and coordinating local efforts.

npc:tharnariun-treetender.text: Tharnariun Treetender. Tharnariun Treetender is a night elf naturalist stationed in the coastal settlement of Auberdine in Darkshore. Dedicated to safeguarding the delicate balance of the wild, he monitors the creeping corruption afflicting the regional flora and fauna. Travelers passing through the port often find him calling upon allies to heal diseased beasts and protect nature from further decline. Perched on the rugged coast of Darkshore, the port town of Auberdine faces threats on multiple fronts, from hostile satyrs to foul shoreline washaways. Tharnariun Treetender focuses his efforts squarely on the natural world that surrounds the village. Firmly believing that neglecting nature invites ruin, he spends his time observing the decline of the local woods and seeking ways to push back the sickness spreading across the forest floor.

npc:the-defias-traitor.text: The Defias Traitor. The Defias Traitor is a captured outlaw held at the base of the Sentinel Hill watchtower in Westfall. Caught red-handed by the People's Militia, he traded the secret location of the Brotherhood's headquarters to save his own neck. Not every member of the Defias Brotherhood possesses fanatical loyalty to Edwin VanCleef's cause. When this petty thief was caught attempting to rob Farmer Saldean of his wagon, Gryan Stoutmantle's militia had him dead to rights. Facing the gallows, the thief chose self-preservation over brotherhood, offering up the exact whereabouts of their hidden base of operations in exchange for his life.

npc:theldurin-the-lost.text: Theldurin the Lost. Theldurin the Lost is a reclusive, half-mad dwarf wandering the scorched expanses of the Badlands. Formerly aligned with the insidious Twilight's Hammer cult, he fled their ranks with stolen sacred relics after realizing the horror of their designs. Perched in the barren hills of the Badlands, clutching bags of explosives in wild paranoia, Theldurin is far more than a simple mad hermit. He was once an initiate of the Twilight's Hammer cult. When the sinister cabal sought to awaken a primordial elemental power trapped beneath the earth, Theldurin recoiled in terror, rejected their mad teachings, and fled into the desert. He carried with him the Scroll of Myzrael, desperate to prevent his former masters from unleashing an ancient horror upon the world. Though the escape cost him his sanity, his defiance dealt a serious blow to the cult's plans.

npc:therylune.text: Therylune. Therylune is a dryad found held captive at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. Entrapped by the insidious Twilight's Hammer cultists who have occupied the ancient site, she relies on bold travelers to help her break free and escape their clutches. Dryads are guardians of nature and daughters of Cenarius, normally roaming the tranquil woodlands of northern Kalimdor. However, Therylune ventured too close to the ominous excavation at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, where Twilight's Hammer cultists have gathered. Ambushed and trapped by the dark cult, she is unable to fight her way out alone through the swarms of cultists and requires an escort to flee to safety.

npc:therysil.text: Therysil. Therysil is a dryad dwelling at the Shrine of Aessina in central Ashenvale. Deeply devoted to the preservation of nature, she waits anxiously for word of her sister, Therylune, who fell into the hands of sinister cultists. Therysil makes her home near the tranquil waters of the Shrine of Aessina, a sacred glade within the ancient woods of Ashenvale. Like all dryads, the daughters of Cenarius, she is bound to the defense of the wild and the spirits dwelling within it. Yet her focus has been torn from quiet stewardship to gnawing worry. Her sister, Therylune, was captured nearby by the deranged Twilight's Hammer cult, leaving Therysil desperate for any wandering ally willing to aid in her sister's rescue.

npc:thor.text: Thor. Thor is the gryphon flight master stationed at the gryphon roost at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. As the vital aerial link between the beleaguered People's Militia and the capital city of Stormwind, he oversees the dispatch of couriers, scouts, and urgent messages across kingdom skies. Stationed at Sentinel Hill's gryphon roost, Thor manages the flight roost that ties Westfall's frontier defenders to the heart of the kingdom. While the People's Militia struggles on the ground against roaming bandits, gnolls, and malfunctioning harvest golems, Thor ensures that crucial military dispatches and travelers can bypass the perilous roads altogether. Through his tamed gryphons, urgent requests for aid and reports from Gryan Stoutmantle reach the court in Stormwind far quicker than any ground messenger could manage.

npc:thorgas-grimson.text: Thorgas Grimson. Thorgas Grimson is the resident dwarf hunter trainer stationed inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A seasoned outdoorsman of Dun Morogh, he firmly believes that hands-on survival in the freezing wilds is the finest teacher any fledgling marksman can have. Perched inside the stone halls of Anvilmar, Thorgas Grimson welcomes novice mountaineers and scouts taking their very first steps into the harsh snowdrifts of Coldridge Valley. Rather than bogging young hunters down with dry lectures, Grimson espouses a practical philosophy: real skill is forged out in the freezing winds, bow or gun in hand, tracking Dun Morogh's rugged beasts firsthand.

npc:thorgrum-borrelson.text: Thorgrum Borrelson. Thorgrum Borrelson is the dwarven gryphon master stationed above Thelsamar in Loch Modan. From his roost overlooking the settlement, he tends the aerial mounts that connect the valley to Ironforge and the surrounding mountain passes. Perched on the bluff rising immediately above Thelsamar, Thorgrum Borrelson handles aerial transport for the Alliance across Loch Modan. With trogg incursions and gnoll packs threatening overland paths, his trained gryphons provide vital transit over the jagged ridges. He maintains frequent connections back through the South Gate Pass to the Great Forge in Dun Morogh, as well as routes onward toward the Wetlands and beyond.

npc:thorvald-deepforge.text: Thorvald Deepforge. Thorvald Deepforge is a dwarven weapon merchant stationed near the border pass in the Valley of Kings. He helps arm travelers and defenders securing the critical pathway between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Positioned within the towering monument of the Valley of Kings, Thorvald Deepforge serves the Alliance as a reliable arms dealer. The mountain passes connecting Khaz Modan's interior to the outlying territories are plagued by trogg incursions and roving wildlife, making well-forged steel essential for any Mountaineer or recruit on the road. Thorvald ensures that those arriving from Dun Morogh or heading deeper into Loch Modan carry the blades and axes needed to defend dwarven lands.

npc:thran-khorman.text: Thran Khorman. Thran Khorman is the resident dwarven warrior trainer stationed in Anvilmar, nestled within the snowy Coldridge Valley. He oversees the basic combat drilling for newly minted warriors stepping out into Dun Morogh. Standing near the training grounds of Anvilmar, Thran Khorman is tasked with turning raw dwarven recruits and visiting gnomes into disciplined combatants. He maintains a gruff, uncompromising demeanor toward anyone who lacks the grit for front-line fighting. In his eyes, even though the Third War has concluded, peace is merely an illusion: troggs encroach upon Coldridge Pass, and the mountains remain fraught with peril. He demands relentless practice with axe, mace, and shield so that Ironforge's defenders never grow dull.

npc:thunderaan.text: Thunderaan. Prince Thunderaan is the ancient Prince of Air, a colossal elemental struck down and betrayed during the ancient wars between fire and wind. Consumed in part by Ragnaros the Firelord, his remnant essence was sealed into shattered bindings entrusted to the Firelord's lieutenants. Adventurers who recover these relics can seek out Highlord Demitrian in Silithus to unleash him once more. Long ago, during the Elemental Sundering—a five-thousand-year clash fought between the forces of fire and air deep within Azeroth—Ragnaros sought to destroy and consume Thunderaan. The Prince was ambushed and betrayed by Ragnaros's powerful lieutenants, Baron Geddon and Garr, before being struck down by the Firelord's hammer, Sulfuras. Although defeated, Thunderaan's essence proved too mighty for Ragnaros to fully absorb. Unable to entirely devour the Prince of Air, Ragnaros sealed what little remained of Thunderaan's essence inside a talisman of elemental binding. To prevent the Prince from ever reforming, the Firelord shattered the talisman into two flawless halves. He entrusted one piece to Baron Geddon and the other to Garr, hiding both within the volcanic depths of the Molten Core beneath Blackrock Mountain.

npc:tommy-joe-stonefield.text: Tommy Joe Stonefield. Tommy Joe Stonefield is a young farmer caught in a bitter family rivalry in the heart of Elwynn Forest. Deeply in love with Maybell Maclure, he must rely on quiet riverbanks and secret messages to keep their romance hidden from their feuding kin. Standing by the riverbank just west of the Stonefield Farm, Tommy Joe Stonefield spends his days looking across the water toward the Maclure homestead. The Stonefields and Maclures have harbored bad blood for years, clashing over land, pride, and petty farmyard squabbles. Yet despite the hostility preached by his elders, Tommy Joe has fallen head over heels for Maybell Maclure. Unable to meet openly without sparking outrage from both households, he depends on trusted intermediaries and his sympathetic grandmother, Gramma Stonefield, to exchange secret notes and tokens of affection.

npc:tormus-deepforge.text: Tormus Deepforge. Tormus Deepforge is a dwarven smith working at the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. A dependable craftsman, he coordinates iron deliveries and supplies armaments for Alliance defense efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Positioned right beside the roaring fires of the Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge oversees substantial metalworking tasks on behalf of the Bronzebeard clan. Beyond hammering steel himself, Tormus mourns his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, whose smithing compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh was overrun by Dark Iron dwarves after a load of strange umbral ore arrived there.

npc:torwa-pathfinder.text: Torwa Pathfinder. Torwa Pathfinder is a lone tauren hunter and tracker camped at the entrance to Un'Goro Crater, just below the ramp descending from Tanaris. He observes the basin's primordial wildlife, studying the dangerous predators that rule the jungle floor. Adventurers seeking to test their mettle against the crater's legendary beasts often seek his guidance. Perched at the eastern base of the crater where the desert sands of Tanaris give way to humid jungle steam, Torwa Pathfinder serves as an informal warden for newcomers. He respects the wild forces of Un'Goro, understanding that careless wanderers quickly become fodder for the local fauna. His campsite provides a rare moment of respite before travelers dive into the sweltering depths. Much of Torwa's attention is consumed by Lar'korwi, a notoriously cunning and fierce raptor roaming the northern reaches of the crater. Torwa understands that brute strength alone cannot bring down such an apex predator. Instead, he instructs hunters to study its feeding habits, using fresh carcase meat and glands to craft a bait potent enough to lure the beast out into the open. Beyond hunting the crater's apex raptors, Torwa maintains a deep curiosity regarding the toxic flora and aggressive ape colonies that inhabit the basin. He directs travelers to harvest venom from volatile bloodpetals and observe the strength of dominant beasts like the mighty gorilla U'cha, constantly analyzing how nature's deadliest adaptations function in isolation.

npc:treshala-fallowbrook.text: Treshala Fallowbrook. Treshala Fallowbrook is a night elf residing quietly on the upper level of the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She is the wife of Heralath Fallowbrook, whose work has taken him far from home into the thorny depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens. Treshala Fallowbrook keeps a modest vigil on the second floor of a workshop in Darnassus's Tradesmen's Terrace. Her husband, Heralath, journeyed to the brambled depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens, and she waits at home for word of him. The two are joined by a pendant of bonding, a keepsake of their marriage that Heralath carried with him into the quilboar's warrens.

npc:tsunaman.text: Tsunaman. Tsunaman is a sentient water elemental stationed at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Acting as an agent of the Tribunal of the Tides, he watches over the elemental currents of Kalimdor and rallies Horde adventurers to confront corrupting forces. Dwelling near the path leading from Sun Rock Retreat down into the Charred Vale, Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides, high-ranking servants aligned with the Tidehunter, Neptulon. Rather than showing mindless hostility to mortal travelers, he cooperates with the Horde to monitor elemental unrest throughout Kalimdor, particularly the disturbances rippling out of the submerged caverns of Blackfathom Deeps. True to his elemental nature, Tsunaman harbors an instinctive, visceral hatred for fire in all forms. He constantly fumes over the nearby burning landscapes of the Charred Vale and elemental fire incursions. In camp, his animosity is so petty and unyielding that he regularly marches over to nearby cooking fires and campfires just to smack them out with a heavy fist of water.

npc:tyrion.text: Tyrion. Tyrion is a covert gnome operative stationed inside Stormwind Keep. Operating in the shadows alongside close associates like Elling Trias, he aids adventurers in unearthing sensitive intelligence and combating treacherous plots against the kingdom. Amid the grandeur of Stormwind Keep, Tyrion keeps a low profile. While noble courtiers and royal guards bustle through the halls, this clever gnome operates under the radar, watching palace movements and liaising with outside contacts who operate far from official oversight. Tyrion is a trusted confidant of Elling Trias, the renowned cheese merchant of the Trade District who operates a discreet information network. When sensitive matters arise that require bypassing the official bureaucracy of the House of Nobles, Trias directs reliable operatives straight to Tyrion inside the castle walls.

npc:ukor.text: Ukor. Ukor is an orc peon resting near the eastern path outside the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Eager to help his people, he carried supplies all the way from Razor Hill, only to find the training grounds already had plenty of provisions. While many orc peons spend their lives under the watchful eye of harsh taskmasters cutting lumber or hauling rocks, Ukor attempted to perform a service of his own initiative. Tasked or inspired to bring food from Razor Hill to the recruits training in the Valley of Trials, he made the dangerous trek across Durotar's red plains past prowling scorpid and boars. Upon arrival, he discovered the Valley was already well-stocked and had no need for his bundle. Exhausted and somewhat disheartened by the roadside, he relies on passing young adventurers to return the unused provisions back north to Innkeeper Grosk.

npc:ula-elek.text: Ula'elek. Ula'elek is a Darkspear troll smith residing in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. Working in tandem with the veteran orc smith Thun'grim Firegaze, he crafts specialized armor for Horde warriors striving to prove their worth. His work combines traditional troll craftsmanship with exotic trophies gathered from across Kalimdor. Ula'elek plies his craft amid the huts and braziers of Sen'jin Village, serving the Darkspear tribe as a skilled armorsmith. In a coastal settlement constantly threatened by nearby hostile quilboar and sea crawlers, keeping working blades and sturdy armor ready is vital to the tribe's survival. However, Ula'elek's renown extends beyond local defense, drawing the attention of seasoned warriors across the Horde. When young warriors visit Thun'grim Firegaze atop his overlook in the Barrens, the old veteran directs them south toward Sen'jin Village to seek out Ula'elek. Thun'grim trusts the troll smith to fashion Brutal Gauntlets, an imposing piece of battle gear worthy of battle-hardened frontliners. Ula'elek demands rare materials for the task, most notably the swollen, uncloven hooves of the satyrs who leech the forest's magic in northeastern Ashenvale.

npc:umpi.text: Umpi. Umpi is a frog residing in Tarren Mill as the unwitting laboratory assistant of Apothecary Lydon. Kept inside the Royal Apothecary Society's workshop, she serves as a recurring test subject for experimental toxins and plague concoctions. Within the dark laboratories of Tarren Mill, the Forsaken work tirelessly to brew concoctions of death and torment. For Apothecary Lydon, scientific rigor requires living flesh to test his formulas, and Umpi bears the brunt of these trials. Lydon regularly tests lethal brews—such as the Elixir of Suffering and the Elixir of Agony—directly on her. Once the poisons take their inevitable toll and kill her, the apothecary re-animates the amphibian, ensuring she is ready to endure the next lethal dose for the glory of the Royal Apothecary Society.

npc:undertaker-mordo.text: Undertaker Mordo. Undertaker Mordo is the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell, serving as the very first face newly awakened Forsaken see when they open their eyes. He tells those who wake that they are the Lich King's slaves no more and sends them on toward the Forsaken cause; the bodies that never stir go to the fire. Keeping the crypt of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades, Undertaker Mordo watches over the dead as corpses break free from the Scourge's shattered grip. For every newly liberated Forsaken who wakes in the cold of the crypt, Mordo provides their initial bearing in an unrecognizable second life. He assesses their sanity, introduces them to the reality of their condition, and immediately directs them toward duty under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner. Not every body brought to the crypt wakes. Mordo does not wait long: the corpses that stay still are tossed into the fire, and those who do stir are greeted with dry impatience and little ceremony. Anyone who rises with their wits intact is sent up the steps and down the road to Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel, who explains their new existence. The mindless zombies that overrun the north of the village are Sarvis's concern, not Mordo's; the shadow priest sends the newly risen out to destroy them.

npc:ur-kyo.text: Ur'kyo. Ur'kyo is a revered jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Spirits within Orgrimmar. Known as the spiritual leader and greatest priest among the Darkspear tribe, he guides fledgling practitioners of the spiritual arts in the capital of the Horde. Through his council, priests learn to commune with the spirits and balance the powerful forces of shadow and light. Residing in the serene waters and huts of the Valley of Spirits, Ur'kyo stands as one of the most prominent spiritual authorities in Orgrimmar. For the Darkspear trolls who fled the Echo Isles and forged a home in Durotar alongside Thrall's Horde, maintaining their sacred traditions is essential. Ur'kyo preserves these ancestral practices, serving as a pillar of spiritual discipline and guidance for tribal mystics and visiting practitioners alike. Priests walking the path of faith find a patient instructor in Ur'kyo. He oversees traditional training and ancient rites, including teachings that bestow the Hex of Weakness and the defensive ward known as Shadowguard. Ur'kyo also acts as a liaison for Horde priests seeking to understand the diverse spiritual practices within their coalition, helping them bridge the gap between troll voodoo, ancestral ways, and foreign disciplines.

npc:uzzek.text: Uzzek. Uzzek is a battle-hardened orc veteran stationed just southwest of the Far Watch Post in the Barrens. Having survived countless skirmishes across Kalimdor, he now helps evaluate and temper promising Horde warriors who journey through the arid plains. Perched southwest of Far Watch Post along the eastern border of the Barrens, Uzzek represents the enduring grit of the Horde's frontline fighters. Having endured brutal combat throughout the recent wars, he serves as an instructor and trial-giver to younger warriors seeking to master their defensive disciplines. To prove oneself to Uzzek requires testing one's mettle against the savage wildlife and raiders that plague the arid crossing.

npc:valstag-ironjaw.text: Valstag Ironjaw. Valstag Ironjaw is an Ironforge dwarven soldier stationed within Menethil Keep in the coastal marshlands of the Wetlands. Facing the pressing dangers that plague the trade passages connecting Loch Modan and the coast, he assists in securing regional routes and keeping the harbor's garrison informed of local threats. Found inside Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor, Valstag Ironjaw serves as part of the dwarven garrison keeping watch over the lowlands. The surrounding marsh is rife with danger, from hostile Dragonmaw orcs to ravenous wildlife, making communications and supply lines difficult to maintain. Valstag helps coordinate defense efforts along the primary thoroughfares, particularly the treacherous passage cutting through Dun Algaz toward Loch Modan. With the treacherous Algaz Gauntlet choked by hostile forces, travelers and supply convoys heading between Menethil Harbor and Loch Modan are under constant threat. Valstag directs capable adventurers to confront the brigands and orcs lurking in the passes, relaying crucial military intelligence back and forth between forward scouts and commanders like Captain Stoutfist.

npc:vanndar-stormpike.text: Vanndar Stormpike. Vanndar Stormpike is a fierce dwarf mountain king who commands the Stormpike Expedition from the northern fortress of Dun Baldar. Searching the frozen peaks of Alterac Valley for ancient relics and raw resources, he leads the Alliance's unyielding war against the Frostwolf orcs. A veteran mountain king of Ironforge, Vanndar Stormpike spearheads the dwarven excavation into Alterac Valley. Following the Third War, he marched the Stormpike Guard into the northern mountains seeking hidden mineral riches and long-lost titan artifacts. Settling into the fortified redoubt of Dun Baldar, Vanndar views the valley as an ancestral right and rightful Alliance territory. He directs military outposts, defensive bunkers, and frontline pushes with grim dwarven resolve, determined that no retreat will ever be sounded under his watch. Vanndar's relentless mining and prospecting encroached directly onto the home of the Frostwolf clan, sparking brutal mountain warfare. Despite orcish demands to withdraw, Vanndar refuses to yield an inch of ground, vowing that Alterac Valley will belong to the dwarves. From his throne room deep within Dun Baldar, flanked by his marshals and bodyguards, he personally oversees the defense against Frostwolf incursions while dispatching Alliance champions to break the enemy lines and claim the valley once and for all.

npc:varok-saurfang.text: Varok Saurfang. High Overlord Saurfang is a legendary orc warrior and a veteran of the Old Horde's wars. Serving as Warchief Thrall's trusted military commander in Orgrimmar, he represents the proud martial spine of the modern Horde. Few living warriors possess a martial pedigree to rival Saurfang. A veteran of the Old Horde's wars, he is considered an unstoppable force on the battlefield. Today he stands in Orgrimmar as High Overlord, a bulwark of Thrall's newborn Horde. Though he stands as an unmatched champion of the Horde, Saurfang is not driven by reckless battle-lust. While he will relentlessly defend the Horde and enforce Thrall's rule against any threat, Saurfang harbors a profound disdain for warmongering and fights strictly for honor and preservation.

npc:velarok.text: Velarok. Velarok Windblade is a lone human swordsman camped amid the ash and cinder of Searing Gorge, flanked by the mutilated corpses of Dark Iron dwarves. He seeks vengeance against the local Dark Irons for the brutal murder of his father, recruiting passing travelers to forge a weapon of retribution. His single-minded hunger for vengeance drives everything he asks of those who help him. Found southeast of Thorium Point, Velarok Windblade presents himself as a grieving human warrior stranded in the perilous wastes of the Searing Gorge. Surrounding his camp are the bloody, battered corpses of Dark Iron dwarves who crossed his blade. According to Velarok, these clan dwarves slaughtered his father in cold blood. Consumed by hatred, he enlists travelers to gather materials to assemble the Torch of Retribution, an enchanted weapon of vengeance against the Dark Irons and the minions of Ragnaros.

npc:velora-nitely.text: Velora Nitely. Velora Nitely is an undead armorsmith residing in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. Renowned as one of the finest smiths in Lordaeron before the kingdom fell, she now puts her cold craftsmanship to work for the Forsaken and the Horde. Despite her grim existence, she attempts dry, deadpan jokes that rarely land. Before the Third War devastated the north, Velora Nitely was celebrated across Lordaeron as an exceptional armorsmith. Though undeath stripped her of life and warmth, it left her technical skill untouched. Now stationed near the anvils of the Undercity's Trade Quarter, she collaborates across continents with Horde crafters like Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens. Her specialty includes reinforcing heavy battle plate, notably forging the formidable Brutal Legguards from hardened materials such as Dragonmaw shinbones. Unlike many of her somber Forsaken kin who brood over their cursed fate, Velora maintains an appetite for levity. Unfortunately, dying seems to have thoroughly ruined her comedic timing. Her quips come across flat, morbid, and thoroughly unfunny to the living and dead alike, though she continues to crack them undeterred while working the forge.

npc:ventaari-brightwish.text: Ventaari Brightwish. Ventaari Brightwish is a Skyborne resident of Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. She greets travelers from across Azeroth and offers the quest The Gift of Skysight. Residing in Thendal Village upon the soaring cliffs of Zephras Isle, Ventaari Brightwish is one of the local Skyborne. While she shares a surname with Belathaan Brightwish, her own duties center around aiding newcomers who find their way to the village, extending hospitality to both the Alliance and the Horde as she initiates visitors into the traditions of her people through tasks like The Gift of Skysight.

npc:verna-furlbrow.text: Verna Furlbrow. Verna Furlbrow is an evicted farmer currently stranded beside her broken-down wagon near the northern border of Westfall. After bandits seized her family's pumpkin patch, she and her husband attempted to flee toward Elwynn Forest, only to find themselves stuck on the dangerous open road. Verna and her husband once worked their own pumpkin farm in northern Westfall, but the rising tide of lawlessness sweeping the countryside drove them out. When outlaws overran their land, the couple piled what possessions they could onto their cart and hitched up their faithful horse, Old Blanchy, intending to escape to the safety of Elwynn Forest. Disastrously, their wagon broke down just down the road from the abandoned Jansen Stead. With no means to repair the axle or move forward, Verna has been left to endure the elements, bandit raids, and scavengers while relying on traveling adventurers to keep her household fed and guarded. Despite being reduced to squatting along the roadside, Verna maintains a welcoming and resourceful spirit. Known across the region as the creator of Westfall Stew, she regularly shares meals and warm fires with wandering transients and refugees who have suffered similar fates. She relies on passing wanderers to scour the fields for ingredients—such as boar snouts, murloc eyes, okra, and stringy vulture meat—to replenish her cooking pot, transforming whatever the harsh frontier yields into hearty sustenance for the destitute.

npc:veron-amberstill.text: Veron Amberstill. Veron Amberstill is a dwarven ram breeder residing at Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh. He tends to the rugged mountain rams that serve as the traditional mounts of Ironforge and offers them to skilled riders who have earned his trust. Tucked away in the snow-dusted hills of eastern Dun Morogh, Veron Amberstill oversees the celebrated stock of Amberstill Ranch. Mountain rams are perfectly suited for Khaz Modan's treacherous slopes, sure-footed and thick-coated against the bite of mountain blizzards. Veron breeds and trains these beasts to carry dwarven scouts, mountaineers, and traveling adventurers. While he gladly provides standard and swift mounts to fellow dwarves, outsiders must prove their unwavering loyalty to the throne of Ironforge before he will part with any of his prized herd.

npc:veronica-nials.text: Veronica Nials. Captain Veronica Nials is an officer of the Stromgarde military stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Amid the kingdom's collapse, she coordinates defensive operations against the Syndicate and ogres that overrun the fallen capital. Following the Third War, the human kingdom of Stromgarde shattered, leaving its remnants struggling to survive against invading Boulderfist ogres and the treachery of the Syndicate. Captain Veronica Nials stands as one of the central commanders of the surviving Stromgarde defenders at Refuge Pointe. Tasked with holding the line, she directs Alliance champions against key Syndicate leadership, such as Lord Falconcrest and the warlock Marez Cowl, while striving to recover fallen soldiers' badges so their grieving families can find closure. Captain Nials's loyalties are strictly tied to her battered homeland. When Rhag Garmason and the dwarven defenders of Dun Modr begged for Stromgarde's assistance after Dark Iron saboteurs devastated the Thandol Span, Nials was forced to turn them away. Bound by honor and duty, her troops cannot spare a single blade beyond the Arathi Highlands while their own ancestral kingdom remains occupied.

npc:vesprystus.text: Vesprystus. Vesprystus is the night elf flight master stationed at the docks of Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil. He oversees the roost of trained hippogryphs that carry travelers between the great World Tree and mainland Kalimdor. Perched at the southern base of Teldrassil in Rut'theran Village, Vesprystus tends the hippogryphs that bridge the isolated elven boughs to the rest of the world.
